AI.title_translation: 多智能体大模型流水线中的对抗攻击：揭示智能体AI架构中的结构性漏洞
AI.tldr: 多智能体大模型流水线由于缺乏边界验证，普遍存在结构性安全漏洞，攻击成功与否主要取决于流水线架构而非模型本身的能力。
AI.motivation: 多智能体大模型流水线通过在多个智能体间传递中间输出完成复杂任务，但缺乏边界验证，导致对抗性内容在流水线中被当作可信输入传播，从而产生独特的结构性安全隐患。
AI.method: 利用来自GAIA和SWE-Bench基准测试的标注生产追踪进行分析，并在控制的多智能体环境中对GPT-5-mini、Claude Sonnet 4.5和Kimi K2.5进行跨配置评估。
AI.result: 研究表明，这些漏洞在良性部署中也会出现且常规评估框架难以察觉；攻击成功率与流水线结构紧密相关而非模型能力，说明对抗性漏洞本质上是一种架构属性。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体大模型流水线存在由隐式信任引发的结构性安全漏洞，攻击成功率取决于架构而非模型能力，亟需引入基于流水线的边界验证等防御机制。
AI.translation: 多智能体大模型流水线将多个专门的语言模型智能体编排到结构化工作流中，其中中间输出在智能体之间传递以解决复杂任务。这种设计引入了单智能体设置中所没有的安全缺口：一旦某个智能体接受了对抗性内容，它就会作为可信输入在整个流水线中传播。我们认为，这种脆弱性源于缺乏边界验证（一种安全原语，用于在数据穿过智能体间边界时强制进行显式验证，包括内容、身份、执行意图和状态完整性）。如果没有这种验证，现代流水线就会嵌入在对抗环境下不够稳健的隐式信任假设，从而产生结构上截然不同的攻击面（例如内容注入、智能体冒充、计划偏离和记忆投毒）。利用来自GAIA和SWE-bench基准测试的标注生产追踪，我们证明了这些漏洞出现在良性部署中，并且很大程度上逃避了现有的评估框架。我们在受控的多智能体环境中进一步将这些失效模式操作化，并在相同的流水线配置下对GPT-5-mini、Claude Sonnet 4.5和Kimi K2.5进行了评估。结果表明，攻击成功率与流水线结构相一致，而不是与模型能力相一致，这表明对抗性脆弱性本质上是一种架构属性，并促使向流水线级防御的转变。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了多智能体大模型流水线中的对抗性攻击，指出缺乏边界验证导致了独特的结构性安全漏洞。通过对多个主流模型的实验，作者发现攻击成功率取决于流水线架构而非模型能力，强调了开发流水线级防御措施的必要性。
AI.keywords: 多智能体大模型, 对抗攻击, 安全漏洞, 架构设计, 边界验证
AI.comments: 本文揭示了多智能体大模型流水线中结构性的安全漏洞，指出对抗攻击的成功与否取决于流水线架构而非大模型本身的能力，具有重要的安全指导意义。

title: CascadeLUT: Information-Ordered Streaming Inference for Bandwidth-Constrained FPGAs
comments: To appear in the proceedings of the 36th International Conference on Field-Programmable Logic and Applications (FPL 2026). 6 pages, 2 figures
summary: Mapping neural networks to FPGAs enables low-latency, energy-efficient inference, particularly for lookup table (LUT)-based models that eliminate multipliers and map directly to reconfigurable fabric. While prior work achieves high compute efficiency, it typically assumes full-sample availability, causing pipeline stalls in bandwidth-limited streaming scenarios. Here, the bottleneck shifts from computation to data movement, as large input transfers limit throughput and energy efficiency. We present CascadeLUT, an information-structured inference framework organized around bandwidth constraints. Instead of buffering the full input, features are partitioned into ordered subsets and predictions are progressively refined as subsets arrive. The cascade statically controls which layers consume incoming features, enabling deterministic streaming inference without runtime branching. By co-designing feature scheduling with hardware dataflow, CascadeLUT reduces data movement while maintaining accuracy. Across datasets, it achieves 4.0 to 12.5 times lower latency, 3.0 to 5.0 times higher throughput and up to 13.8 times lower energy/sample than prior LUT baselines, using 1.2 to 4.4 times the LUTs of the smallest DWN baseline per task. We also demonstrate on-device input quantization integrated with LUT-based inference and present end-to-end FPGA results on real-world workloads, with 5 times reductions in quantization overhead.

AI.title_translation: CascadeLUT：面向带宽受限FPGA的信息有序流式推理
AI.tldr: CascadeLUT是一种面向带宽受限FPGA的LUT神经网络流式推理框架，通过信息有序的特征级联调度，大幅降低了数据移动瓶颈，实现了更低的延迟、更高的吞吐量和更好的能效。
AI.motivation: 在带宽受限的流式场景中，将神经网络映射到基于查找表（LUT）的FPGA时，瓶颈从计算转移到了数据移动，大输入传输限制了吞吐量和能效，现有的全样本假设会导致流水线停顿。
AI.method: 提出了CascadeLUT框架，将特征划分为有序子集，随着子集到达逐步精炼预测；利用级联静态控制层对输入特征的消费，实现无运行时分支的确定性流式推理，并进行特征调度与硬件数据流的协同设计。
AI.result: 相比先前的LUT基准，CascadeLUT实现了4.0至12.5倍的低延迟、3.0至5.0倍的高吞吐量、高达13.8倍的每样本低能耗，同时在真实世界负载上实现了5倍的量化开销降低。
AI.conclusion: CascadeLUT通过信息排序的特征调度与硬件数据流协同设计，成功克服了带宽受限FPGA上LUT模型的输入传输瓶颈，在保持准确率的同时大幅提升了延迟、吞吐量和能效。
AI.translation: 将神经网络映射到FPGA可以实现低延迟、高能效的推理，特别是对于消除乘法器并直接映射到可重构结构的基于查找表（LUT）的模型。虽然先前的研究实现了很高的计算效率，但它们通常假设全样本可用，在带宽受限的流式场景中会导致流水线停顿。此时，瓶颈从计算转移到了数据移动，因为大输入传输限制了吞吐量和能效。我们提出了CascadeLUT，这是一个围绕带宽限制组织的信息结构化推理框架。特征不是缓冲完整输入，而是被划分为有序子集，并随着子集的到达逐步精炼预测。级联静态控制哪些层消耗传入的特征，从而实现无需运行时分支的确定性流式推理。通过将特征调度与硬件数据流协同设计，CascadeLUT在保持准确率的同时减少了数据移动。在各个数据集上，与先前的LUT基准相比，它的延迟降低了4.0到12.5倍，吞吐量提高了3.0到5.0倍，每样本能耗降低高达13.8倍，每个任务使用的LUT数量是最小DWN基准的1.2到4.4倍。我们还展示了与基于LUT推理集成的片上输入 quantization，并在真实世界工作负载上展示了端到端的FPGA结果，量化开销减少了5倍。
AI.summary: CascadeLUT是一个针对带宽受限FPGA的推理框架，它通过将输入特征组织成有序子集并逐步精炼预测，消除了全样本缓冲带来的流水线停顿，从而在显著降低延迟和能耗的同时大幅提升了吞吐量。
AI.keywords: FPGA, 查找表(LUT), 流式推理, 带宽受限, 神经网络协同设计
AI.comments: 本文针对带宽受限FPGA上的查找表（LUT）神经网络推理，创新性地提出了信息排序的流式推理框架CascadeLUT。通过将特征划分为有序子集并进行渐进式预测，有效解决了数据传输瓶颈，显著提升了吞吐量并降低了延迟与能耗，具有很高的实用价值和硬件协同设计创新性。

title: OmniAI: A Surface-Adaptive Aerial Projection Interface for Human--Drone Interaction
summary: Drones in human environments often lack spatially grounded in- terfaces for situated communication. We present OmniAI, an em- bodied aerial agent that supports surface-adaptive interaction by switching projection between an onboard screen and nearby en- vironmental surfaces. A servo-actuated MEMS laser projector renders text-and-image responses from a web-augmented LLM pipeline. Projection surfaces are detected online using RGB-D sensing and RANSAC plane fitting, without pre-mapped geometry. OmniAI provides functionally equivalent voice and gesture con- trol for both drone motion and projected content. By combining speech, mid-air gestures, adaptive projection, and aerial mobility, OmniAI demonstrates a mobile spatial AR interface for context- aware human-drone interaction.

AI.title_translation: OmniAI：一种用于人机交互的表面自适应空中投影接口
AI.tldr: OmniAI是一种新型空中投影无人机接口，能够利用机载投影仪、RGB-D感知和LLM在周围环境表面上自适应投影内容，并支持语音与手势交互。
AI.motivation: 人类环境中的无人机通常缺乏用于情境通信的空间具身接口，因此需要开发一种能够支持表面自适应交互的空中投影接口。
AI.method: 开发了一个具身空中智能体OmniAI，采用伺服驱动的MEMS激光投影仪在机载屏幕和环境表面之间切换投影；使用RGB-D传感和RANSAC平面拟合在线检测投影表面（无需预先映射几何结构）；结合了基于Web增强的LLM管道，并支持语音和空中手势控制。
AI.result: OmniAI实现了在车载屏幕与周围环境表面之间的自适应投影切换，支持实时表面检测，并提供了功能对等的语音和手势控制无人机运动及投影内容。
AI.conclusion: OmniAI成功展示了一种集成了语音、手势、自适应投影和空中机动性的移动空间AR接口，为上下文感知的人机交互提供了新范式。
AI.translation: 人类环境中的无人机通常缺乏用于情境通信的空间接地接口。我们提出了OmniAI，这是一个具身的空中智能体，它通过在机载屏幕和临近环境表面之间切换投影，支持表面自适应交互。由伺服驱动的MEMS激光投影仪呈现来自网络增强LLM管道的文本和图像响应。投影表面使用RGB-D感应和RANSAC平面拟合进行在线检测，无需预先映射几何结构。OmniAI为无人机运动和投影内容提供功能上等效的语音和手势控制。通过将语音、空中手势、自适应投影和空中机动性相结合，OmniAI展示了一个用于情境感知人机交互的移动空间AR接口。
AI.summary: OmniAI是一个具身的空中智能体，通过结合机载屏幕、伺服驱动的MEMS激光投影仪、RGB-D传感与LLM管道，实现了在环境表面上的自适应投影。它支持语音和手势控制，提供了一种情境感知的移动空间AR人机交互界面。
AI.keywords: 人机交互, 无人机, 空间增强现实, 投影接口, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将微型激光投影仪、RGB-D感知与大语言模型结合，赋予了无人机动态表面投影和空间增强现实（AR）交互能力，打破了传统无人机缺乏空间具身交互界限的痛点。

title: SelfWAM: A Self-Grounded Unified World Action Model for Fast Robot Control
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by jointly modeling actions and future observations. However, conditioning future prediction only on the task prompt and observation context risks capturing generic task progression rather than the action-specific consequences of the executed action. We introduce SelfWAM, a unified self-grounded WAM built on a modality-specialized Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture that jointly predicts actions, action-conditioned future RGB frames, and robot self-masks, thereby grounding future prediction in the robot's visible body and its action-induced motion. During joint training, SelfWAM allows future visual queries to attend to a clean copy of the demonstrated action, turning the video branch into an action-specific consequence model while leaving the fast action-only inference path unchanged. To focus video learning on action-relevant visual changes, we use prompt-specific objectives for future robot self-mask prediction, which removes appearance details and provides a target whose temporal evolution is tightly coupled with the conditioning action. Together, clean-action conditioning and future self-mask supervision make future predictions more directly reflect how the executed action changes the robot's visible motion and the surrounding scene. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and real-world manipulation tasks show that SelfWAM produces more action-sensitive futures and preserves fast policy inference, while improving policy performance.

AI.title_translation: SelfWAM：一种用于快速机器人控制的自基础统一世界动作模型
AI.tldr: 现有的世界动作模型（WAMs）在捕捉动作特定后果方面存在不足。SelfWAM通过一种新的架构和自遮罩技术，将未来预测建立在机器人的可见身体和动作引起的运动上，从而提高了动作敏感性，保持了快速推理，并提升了策略性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的世界动作模型（WAMs）在预测未来时，仅以任务提示和观测上下文为条件，这可能导致模型捕捉到通用的任务进展，而非执行动作的特定后果。
AI.method: SelfWAM是一种统一的自基础世界动作模型，建立在模态专用Transformer混合（MoT）架构之上。它联合预测动作、动作条件下的未来RGB帧和机器人自遮罩，从而将未来预测建立在机器人的可见身体及其动作引起的运动上。在联合训练期间，SelfWAM允许未来的视觉查询关注演示动作的“干净”副本，将视频分支转化为一个动作特定的后果模型，同时保持快速的纯动作推理路径不变。为了使视频学习专注于与动作相关的视觉变化，SelfWAM使用针对提示的未来机器人自遮罩预测目标，这消除了外观细节，并提供了一个时间演变与条件动作紧密耦合的目标。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0和真实世界操纵任务上的实验表明，SelfWAM能生成对动作更敏感的未来预测，并保持快速策略推理，同时提高了策略性能。
AI.conclusion: SelfWAM通过其创新的自基础和自遮罩方法，成功解决了现有世界动作模型在捕捉动作特定后果方面的不足，从而在机器人控制中实现了更精确、更高效的动作预测和策略性能提升。
AI.translation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过联合建模动作和未来观测来改进机器人策略学习。然而，仅以任务提示和观测上下文为条件进行未来预测，存在捕捉通用任务进展而非执行动作特定后果的风险。我们引入了SelfWAM，一个统一的自基础世界动作模型，它建立在模态专用Transformer混合（MoT）架构之上，联合预测动作、动作条件下的未来RGB帧和机器人自遮罩，从而将未来预测建立在机器人的可见身体及其动作引起的运动上。在联合训练期间，SelfWAM允许未来的视觉查询关注演示动作的“干净”副本，将视频分支转化为一个动作特定的后果模型，同时保持快速的纯动作推理路径不变。为了使视频学习专注于与动作相关的视觉变化，我们对未来机器人自遮罩预测使用针对提示的目标，这消除了外观细节，并提供了一个其时间演变与条件动作紧密耦合的目标。总而言之，干净动作条件和未来自遮罩监督使未来预测更直接地反映执行动作如何改变机器人的可见运动和周围场景。在RoboTwin 2.0和真实世界操纵任务上的实验表明，SelfWAM能生成对动作更敏感的未来预测，并保持快速策略推理，同时提高了策略性能。
AI.summary: SelfWAM旨在解决现有世界动作模型（WAMs）在捕捉动作特定后果方面的不足。它引入了一种自基础的统一世界动作模型，采用模态专用Transformer混合架构，联合预测动作、动作条件下的未来RGB帧和机器人自遮罩。通过将未来预测建立在机器人的可见身体和动作引起的运动上，并结合干净动作条件和未来自遮罩监督，SelfWAM能够生成对动作更敏感的未来预测，同时保持快速推理，并在操纵任务中显著提升机器人策略性能。
AI.keywords: 世界动作模型, 机器人控制, 自基础, Transformer混合, 自遮罩
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于通过机器人自遮罩（self-masks）和“干净动作条件”（clean-action conditioning）在MoT架构内实现了未来预测的“自基础”（self-grounding）。这直接解决了现有世界动作模型（WAMs）在捕捉动作特定后果方面的核心局限性，使其在机器人控制中更加有效。同时，在提高性能的同时保持快速推理的能力，对于实际机器人应用至关重要。

title: Foveated Probes Recover Localized Binding Information in Vision Foundation Models
summary: Frozen vision foundation models are commonly evaluated through a single global image embedding, but this interface can conflate missing information with information lost at readout time. We study this distinction by keeping a pretrained vision encoder frozen and varying only the readout applied to its final patch tokens. We compare standard global readouts against a lightweight foveated readout, which attention-pools patch tokens using a learned or question-conditioned query, and against an oracle readout with access to the annotated target region. We evaluate these interfaces on three localized binding problems: a controlled synthetic color--shape binding task under clutter, a color-free crowded shape-detection variant, and a GQA-derived natural-image task where paired questions ask for the colors of different same-category objects in the same image. Global readouts perform near perfectly when the synthetic target appears alone, but collapse under clutter and counterfactual target edits, whereas the foveated readout recovers most of the oracle-accessible signal. On the GQA-derived task, question-independent global image vectors improve only modestly over question-only priors, while question-conditioned foveation substantially improves paired localized color accuracy. A counterfactual nuisance-to-signal ratio explains the synthetic failures: global pooling dilutes localized label-changing evidence while exposing the probe to nuisance variation from irrelevant objects. These results indicate that apparent spatial blindness in frozen vision models can arise from the global embedding interface rather than from an absence of spatial information in the frozen patch tokens.

AI.title_translation: 中央凹探针恢复视觉基础模型中的局部绑定信息
AI.tldr: 冻结的视觉模型本身具有空间信息，其表现出的空间盲视主要由全局嵌入接口引起，而通过中央凹探针可以有效恢复局部绑定信息。
AI.motivation: 冻结的视觉基础模型通常通过单一的全局图像嵌入进行评估，这种接口可能会将缺失的信息与在读出时丢失的信息混淆。论文旨在研究这种区分，并探究视觉模型表面上的“空间盲视”是由于空间信息缺失还是全局嵌入接口导致的。
AI.method: 固定预训练视觉编码器，对比标准全局读出、轻量级中央凹读出（使用学习或问题条件查询对patch tokens进行注意力池化）以及访问标注目标区域的神谕读出（oracle readout），并在合成及自然图像任务上进行评估。
AI.result: 全局读落在复杂背景和反事实目标编辑下会崩溃，而中央凹读出能够恢复大部分神谕可访问的信号；在GQA衍生任务中，问题条件化的中央凹化显著提升了配对的局部颜色准确率。错误分析表明，全局池化稀释了局部标签改变的证据并暴露于不相关的干扰中。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的视觉基础模型本身包含丰富的空间和局部绑定信息，但传统的全局嵌入接口无法有效提取。使用轻量级的中央凹探针能够显著恢复这些局部信息。
AI.translation: 冻结的视觉基础模型通常通过单一的全局图像嵌入来进行评估，但这种接口可能会将缺失的信息与在读出时丢失的信息混淆起来。我们通过保持预训练的视觉编码器冻结并仅改变应用于其最终patch tokens的读出来研究这种区别。我们将标准的全局读出与轻量级的中央凹读出（使用学习的或问题条件化的查询对patch tokens进行注意力池化）以及能够访问标注目标区域的神谕读出进行了比较。我们在三个局部绑定问题上评估了这些接口：一个杂乱背景下的受控合成颜色-shape绑定任务、一个无颜色的拥挤shape检测变体，以及一个衍生自GQA的自然图像任务（其中成对的问题要求回答同一图像中不同同类对象的颜色）。当合成目标单独出现时，全局读出表现近乎完美，但在杂乱背景和反事实目标编辑下会崩溃，而中央凹读出恢复了大部分神谕可访问的信号。在GQA派生的任务中，与问题无关的全局图像向量相比于仅基于问题的先验只有小幅提升，而问题条件化的中央凹化则大幅提升了成对局部颜色的准确率。反事实的干扰-信号比解释了合成任务的失败原因：全局池化稀释了局部标签改变的证据，同时使探针暴露于来自不相关对象的干扰变化中。这些结果表明，冻结的视觉模型中表面的空间盲视可能源于全局嵌入接口，而不是冻结的patch tokens中缺乏空间信息。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了冻结视觉基础模型中的局部绑定问题，发现模型表面上的空间盲视主要源于全局嵌入接口的限制，而非 patch tokens 中缺乏空间信息。通过引入一种轻量级的中央凹探针，可以有效地从冻结模型中恢复出局部的绑定信息。
AI.keywords: 视觉基础模型, 局部绑定, 全局嵌入, 中央凹探针, 空间信息
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地探讨了视觉基础模型在空间信息提取上的局限性并非源于模型本身，而是由于全局嵌入接口的限制。通过引入中央凹探针（foveated readout），论文成功恢复了局部绑定信息，为理解和利用冻结视觉模型提供了新视角。

title: Push-Wiper: Toward General-Purpose Robotic Cleaning across Varied Stains and Surfaces with Segmented Pushing Trajectories
comments: 8 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Viscous stains, characterized by high viscosity and complex rheological properties, remain a major challenge for robotic surface cleaning. Conventional wiping often spreads the stain, while scrubbing provides stronger friction but risks damaging the surface. In this paper, we propose Push-Wiper, a framework that reformulates viscous stain cleaning as an aggregation problem. Push-Wiper employs a sponge to progressively gather stains through segmented pushing trajectories, followed by a post-processing phase that detaches the aggregated material and enables sponge self-cleaning. We adopt a stepwise strategy for stain gathering and leverage Diffusion Policy to generate adaptive pushing action sequences. These sequences are executed through our Arbitrary Surface Pose Interpolator (ASPI) and a hybrid force-position controller, allowing the method to generalize to stains with diverse spatial distributions. Push-Wiper achieves a cleaning score (CS), defined as the percentage of stain area removed, up to 130% higher than baseline methods. Without additional training, Push-Wiper also transfers in a zero-shot manner to solid residues, liquid spills, unseen viscous stains, and curved surfaces with varying geometries. Our experiments demonstrate the cleaning effectiveness of Push-Wiper and its strong generalization ability. The project website is available at https://push-wiper.github.io/.
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)

AI.title_translation: Push-Wiper：通过分段推动轨迹实现跨多种污渍和表面的通用机器人清洁
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Push-Wiper的机器人清洁框架，通过分段推动轨迹和扩散策略高效清除粘性污渍，并具备出色的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统的擦拭容易扩散污渍，而擦洗则存在损伤表面的风险，具有高粘度和复杂流变特性的粘性污渍一直是机器人表面清洁的主要挑战。
AI.method: 提出Push-Wiper框架，采用分段推动轨迹逐步聚集污渍，利用扩散策略生成自适应推动动作序列，并通过任意表面姿态插值器（ASPI）和力位混合控制器进行执行，最后进行后处理以实现自清洁。
AI.result: Push-Wiper的清洁评分（CS）比基线方法高出高达130%，并且无需额外训练就能以零样本方式泛化至固体残留物、液体洒漏、未见过的粘性污渍以及具有不同几何形状的曲面。
AI.conclusion: Push-Wiper框架通过分段推动轨迹、扩散策略以及力位混合控制，有效解决了机器人清洁粘性污渍的难题，并在多种材质和残留物上展现了极强的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 粘性污渍具有高粘度和复杂的流变特性，仍然是机器人表面清洁的主要挑战。传统的擦拭往往会扩散污渍，而擦洗虽然提供了更强的摩擦力，却有损伤表面的风险。在本文中，我们提出了 Push-Wiper，这是一个将粘性污渍清洁重新表述为聚合问题的框架。Push-Wiper 使用海绵通过分段推动轨迹逐步收集污渍，随后进行后处理阶段以剥离聚合材料并实现海绵自清洁。我们采用逐步策略来收集污渍，并利用扩散策略生成自适应的推动动作序列。这些序列通过我们的任意表面姿态插值器（ASPI）和混合力位控制器执行，使该方法能够推广到具有不同空间分布的污渍。Push-Wiper 的清洁评分（CS，定义为去除的污渍面积百分比）比基线方法高出高达 130%。在无需额外训练的情况下，Push-Wiper 还以零样本方式迁移到固体残留物、液体溢出物、未见过的粘性污渍以及具有不同几何形状的曲面。我们的实验证明了 Push-Wiper 的清洁有效性和强大的泛化能力。项目网站可在 https://push-wiper.github.io/ 访问。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Push-Wiper，一个用于多变污渍和表面的通用机器人清洁框架。它将粘性污渍清洁转化为聚合问题，利用海绵、分段推动轨迹、扩散策略和力位混合控制器，实现了高效的污渍清除和强大的零样本泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 机器人清洁, 粘性污渍, 扩散策略, 聚合问题, 泛化能力
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种新颖的“Push-Wiper”框架，将粘性污渍清洁重新定义为一个聚合问题，创新性地使用分段推动轨迹和扩散策略（Diffusion Policy），在机器人表面清洁领域取得了显著的性能提升和零样本泛化能力。

title: Mitigating Backdoors via Decoy Shortcuts and Knowledge Decoupling
summary: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to deep neural networks, especially when training relies on third-party data, allowing adversaries to inject malicious behaviors through data poisoning. In this work, we reveal that backdoor behaviors tend to be absorbed by a simpler parallel branch when jointly trained with the main network. Motivated by this insight, we propose Trapping and Removing (TR), a simple yet effective training-time defense that introduces a lightweight shortcut branch as a "honeypot" to trap backdoor knowledge. After training, backdoors can be removed by discarding the shortcut, without requiring any additional data. To further enhance backdoor isolation while maintaining benign performance, we design a knowledge decoupling strategy with entropy-based weight assignment, encouraging poisoned samples to flow through the honeypot while guiding the main network to focus on benign learning. In addition, we introduce an automatic shortcut generation strategy to improve generalization across model architectures. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets and five model architectures demonstrate that our approach effectively mitigates a wide range of backdoor attacks while preserving performance on benign data. Code: https://github.com/Zixuan-Zhu/TR}{github.com/Zixuan-Zhu/TR.

AI.title_translation: 通过诱饵捷径与知识解耦缓解后门攻击
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于诱饵捷径和知识解耦的新型训练阶段后门防御方法（TR），无需额外数据即可有效捕获并移除神经网络中的后门攻击。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络容易受到基于数据投毒的后门攻击威胁，而作者发现后门行为在与主网络联合训练时倾向于被一个更简单的并行分支所吸收。
AI.method: 提出‘捕获与移除’（TR）防御方法，引入轻量级捷径分支作为诱饵分支来捕获后门知识，设计了带有基于熵的权重分配的知识解耦策略，并采用自动捷径生成策略以提升跨架构的泛化能力。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集和五个模型架构上的广泛实验表明，该方法能够有效缓解各种后门攻击，同时保持模型在良性数据上的性能。
AI.conclusion: TR方法通过引入诱饵捷径和知识解耦，成功在训练阶段实现了对深度神经网络后门攻击的有效防御，且不损失良性数据的准确率。
AI.translation: 后门攻击对深度神经网络构成了严重威胁，尤其是当训练依赖于第三方数据时，攻击者可以通过数据投毒注入恶意行为。在这项工作中，我们发现当与主网络联合训练时，后门行为往往会被一个更简单的并行分支所吸收。受此启发，我们提出了“捕获与移除”（TR）方法，这是一种简单而有效的训练阶段防御手段，它引入了一个轻量级的捷径分支作为“蜜罐”来捕获后门知识。训练结束后，无需任何额外数据，只需丢弃该捷径即可移除后门。为了进一步增强后门隔离并保持良性性能，我们设计了一种带有基于熵的权重分配的知识解耦策略，鼓励中毒样本流经蜜罐，同时引导主网络专注于良性学习。此外，我们引入了一种自动捷径生成策略，以提高跨模型架构的泛化能力。在四个基准数据集和五个模型架构上的大量实验表明，我们的方法有效地缓解了广泛的后门攻击，同时保持了良性数据的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为‘捕获与移除’（TR）的训练阶段防御策略，通过引入轻量级捷径分支（诱饵）来捕获后门知识，并结合知识解耦与熵权分配策略，在不使用额外数据的情况下有效消除了深度神经网络中的后门，同时保持了良性性能。
AI.keywords: 后门防御, 深度神经网络, 知识解耦, 数据投毒, 捷径分支
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的训练阶段防御方法，通过引入轻量级捷径分支作为‘蜜罐’来捕获后门攻击，并通过知识解耦和基于熵的权重分配确保主网络专注于良性学习，无需额外数据即可有效清除后门，具有很高的实用价值。

title: MDTD-ArtIR: Benchmarking Image Editing and Restoration Models for Art Image Restoration under Texture-Overlay Degradations
comments: 15 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Preprint submitted to Elsevier Journal of Visual Communication and Image Representation
summary: Restoring severely degraded visual media still remains a formidable challenge, as existing methods often hallucinate unnatural textures and contents, struggle with preserving color and texture, or fail to leverage partially retained image information. Existing restoration benchmarks assume known degradation operators and fail to capture the complex characteristics of artistic damage such as cracks, stains, and color/texture deviation. We introduce a controlled benchmark for blind restoration of semantic, semi-transparent image media degradations, accompanied by a new, publicly open degradation alpha texture mask dataset MDTD-Art. We present a new dataset and benchmark evaluating state-of-the-art universal restoration models against image editing and vision-language models across varying mask opacity levels. Our experiments demonstrate that image editing models consistently outperform specialized restoration architectures for arbitrary degradations, with performance gains amplified by structured prompt engineering emphasizing detail preservation and structural consistency. These findings position recoverable semantic information and prompt controllability as critical factors in art image restoration.
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Preprint submitted to Elsevier Journal of Visual Communication and Image Representation

AI.title_translation: MDTD-ArtIR：在纹理覆盖退化下基准测试用于艺术图像修复的图像编辑与修复模型
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个艺术图像修复的新基准与数据集，发现图像编辑模型结合提示词工程在处理艺术品复杂损伤时表现优于传统专用修复模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉媒体修复方法在面对严重退化时常常产生不自然的纹理和内容、难以保持色彩和纹理，或者无法利用部分保留的图像信息；同时，现有的修复基准假设降级算子已知，无法捕捉艺术损伤（如裂纹、污渍、色彩/纹理偏差）的复杂特征。
AI.method: 引入了一个受控基准（MDTD-ArtIR）以及一个包含退化alpha纹理掩模的新数据集（MDTD-Art），并在不同掩模不透明度水平下，对最先进的通用修复模型、图像编辑模型和视觉语言模型进行了评估和对比实验。
AI.result: 实验表明，图像编辑模型在任意退化情况下 consistently（始终）优于专门的修复架构，并且通过强调细节保留和结构一致性的结构化提示词工程，性能增益得到了进一步放大。
AI.conclusion: 图像编辑模型在处理艺术图像的复杂退化时表现优于传统专用修复架构，且结构化的提示词工程（Prompt Engineering）能显著提升修复效果，这突显了语义可恢复性和提示词可控性在艺术图像修复中的关键作用。
AI.translation: 恢复严重退化的视觉媒体仍然是一项严峻的挑战，因为现有方法经常产生不自然的纹理和内容，难以保持色彩和纹理，或者未能利用部分保留的图像信息。现有的修复基准假设已知的退化算子，且无法捕捉艺术损伤（如裂纹、污渍以及色彩/纹理偏差）的复杂特征。我们引入了一个用于语义、半透明图像媒体退化盲恢复的受控基准，并伴随一个新的、公开的退化alpha纹理掩模数据集MDTD-Art。我们提出了一个新的数据集和基准，在不同的掩模不透明度水平下，评估了最先进的通用修复模型与图像编辑模型及视觉语言模型。我们的实验表明，在任意退化情况下，图像编辑模型始终优于专门的修复架构，并且通过强调细节保留和结构一致性的结构化提示词工程，性能增益得到了放大。这些发现将可恢复的语义信息和提示可控性定位为艺术图像修复的关键因素。
AI.summary: 该论文针对艺术图像修复提出了一种名为MDTD-ArtIR的新基准和MDTD-Art数据集，用于评估不同模型在纹理覆盖退化下的表现。研究发现，结合结构化提示词工程的图像编辑模型在处理艺术图像损毁时，其性能优于传统的专用修复模型。
AI.keywords: Art Image Restoration, Benchmarking, Texture-Overlay Degradations, Image Editing Models, Prompt Engineering

title: An Embedded RISC-V Evaluation of Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks in Hard-Constrained Recurrent Physics-Informed Models
comments: 6 pages, submitted to SBESC 2026 as an extension to the ICLR Workshop Paper https://openreview.net/forum?id=iHpbQn99RB
summary: Hard-constrained recurrent physics-informed networks (HRPINNs) embed known dynamics inside a recurrent numerical integrator and restrict a neural branch to learning only the residual dynamics that the first-principles model does not capture. Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) have been proposed as parameter-efficient replacements for multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) in such residual branches, but their learnable B-spline activations follow a markedly different execution profile. Building on prior work that characterized when a vanilla B-spline KAN matches or underperforms an MLP as an HRPINN residual branch in discovery accuracy, this paper asks whether that parameter efficiency survives deployment. Using identical trained weights, we measured execution latency, energy per integration step, and dependability under post-training quantization in the closed recurrent loop on a RISC-V RV64GC platform without vector extensions (StarFive VisionFive~2, SiFive U74). For the two accuracy-comparable pairs, the KAN residual branch executed $13.5\times$ and $8.0\times$ slower and consumed $11.3\times$ and $5.6\times$ more energy per integration step (3.7\,$μ$J against 0.33\,$μ$J for the smallest pair); across all four parameter-matched size tiers the ranges are $4.7\times$--$14.5\times$ and $4.7\times$--$18.7\times$. Under INT8 quantization, KAN trajectories diverged up to $43\times$ earlier than matched MLPs; the damage traces to weight quantization, not to input-side knot-interval misassignment. These results indicate that the parameter efficiency reported for KANs does not transfer to deployment cost on scalar embedded cores, and that an MLP residual branch is the more dependable default for embedded HRPINN deployment unless specific quantization co-design is used.

AI.title_translation: 硬约束循环物理信息模型中柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络的嵌入式RISC-V评估

title: EduPluginBench: Executable Assurance for AI-Generated Educational Plugins
comments: 27 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM)
summary: Code-generation models can produce executable components, but compilation and functional tests do not establish compliance with least privilege, telemetry consent, provenance, privileged-write authority, lifecycle constraints, or bounded failure. We introduce EduPluginBench, an executable benchmark and staged admission method for generated plugins in governed software ecosystems. Across 1,440 activation-checked first-order mutants from 30 specifications, P0-P4 increased release-blocking-defect recall by 74.7 percentage points (specification-clustered 95% CI 73.4-75.8) over P0-P2, with no observed rejection among 120 clean references (95% Wilson upper bound 3.1%). A frozen transfer study of 600 unmodified generations from two current coding models found that 300/600 parsed, but none passed P0 or achieved P0-P4 conformance (95% upper bound 0.64%); downstream assurance estimands were undefined. An independently labelled Moodle study retained 16 vulnerable/fixed pairs; the frozen generic PHP detector found no vulnerable revisions. These negative transfer results prevent controlled contract consistency from being read as independent real-defect effectiveness. An earlier 540-generation diagnostic found that post-hoc bounded repair yielded 112 P0 passes, all nonconforming, with recall increasing from 13.4% to 100%. The artifact retains protocols, public-source provenance, raw generations, row-level decisions, audits, analysis code, and reproduction instructions.

title: Multi-tenant Kubernetes Use Cases for AI, Secure Computing and Data Services, and More
summary: Kubernetes, as a container orchestration engine, has been widely used in cloud-native ecosystems for several years. In supercomputing ecosystems, especially where bare-metal performance for compute and network devices are considered, the adoption is somewhat limited. However, with the increasing diversity of use cases such as AI, secure and confidential computing for sensitive data, and mixed workload orchestration, a traditional, single-tenant batch computing system does not offer the flexibility and reproducibility to which public cloud users are accustomed. Note that Kubernetes is not considered a replacement for batch scheduling systems, which have powerful features for large-scale MPI jobs with thousands of network end points. Rather, it is a complementary service provided as part of a national AI Research Resource. We evaluate Kubernetes deployment on a Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Cray EX supercomputerwith HPE Slingshot interconnect, called Isambard-AI, with co-design use cases. One is a Trusted Research Environment used for medical and health sciences. The other combines KubeRay, Ray, and vLLM to provide a distributed, sandboxed, persistent AI model hosting service targeting multi-tenant confidential computing. We discuss challenges and lessons learned, and where further development is needed to offer a production Kubernetes-as-a-Service on HPE Cray EX (and later) platforms.

title: LUT: Latent Utility Training for Visual Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models have advanced visual understanding, yet perception-intensive reasoning remains challenging. Recent latent visual reasoning methods introduce hidden-space computation before answering, but they often rely on costly intermediate supervision, such as bounding boxes, sketches, or interleaved rationales. These strategies focus on how latent states should be shaped, but do not explicitly assess whether the latent is useful for the final answer. We propose LUT, a latent reasoning framework trained with only standard VQA pairs. LUT centers training on Latent Utility at two levels. At the trajectory level, we propose Utility-Aware Latent Distillation SFT, which explores answer-relevant latent trajectories, selects qualified trajectories by their information gain, and distills more reliable and learnable supervision through curriculum learning. At the step level, we propose Latent Attribution Policy Optimization, which uses answer-to-latent attribution to differentially optimize latent steps during reinforcement learning. Experiments on perception-intensive visual reasoning benchmarks show that LUT outperforms previous latent reasoning methods and remains competitive with latent-text interleaved methods with lower annotation cost.

title: Behavioral Grammar: Detecting Adaptive Malware via Tiny Language Model Priors and Second-Order Temporal Analysis
summary: Modern endpoint detection systems face a fundamental tension: signature-based approaches are trivially evaded by polymorphic or adaptive threats, while heavy deep-learning models resist auditability and deployment at scale. This paper presents Behavioral Grammar, a detection architecture that treats host runtime behavior as a structured language and learns its grammar with a compact 0.88M-parameter causal Transformer (TinyGPT). Each system event is discretized into an 8-token representation spanning event type, process, argument skeleton, path category, parent process, user, destination, and inter-event timing. The model learns the conditional distribution of normal behavior in a purely self-supervised manner, and anomaly scores are derived from per-slot negative log-likelihood (NLL) statistics, yielding a mathematically bounded false-positive rate. We augment this prior with prototype learning for known-attack attribution, second-order temporal analysis for cadence-based detection, self-learning pattern extraction, and a five-network fusion pipeline. Against an Adaptive Adversarial Agent (AAA)--a threat that learns survival strategies under defensive pressure, performs behavioral mimicry, and matches host event rates--our system achieves 93% detection at 3.84% onboarding false-positive rate. The strongest discriminative signal arises not from any single event but from the coefficient of variation of inter-event intervals: the AAA stepping cadence exhibits CV=0.310 versus 9.786 for benign sleep intervals, a 30x separation reflecting a fundamental stealth-functionality trade-off. We frame these findings within a coevolutionary economics model, arguing that behavior-grammar detection shifts the evasion cost from rule circumvention (cheap) to distribution matching (expensive), establishing a structural asymmetry favoring the defender.

title: When Prompts Control Robots: Prompt Injection Attacks in Multi-Agent Robotic Systems
summary: Large language models are increasingly integrated into autonomous robotic systems for task planning and control, but this integration exposes them to prompt injection attacks that can lead to unsafe decisions and physical harm. Multi-agent settings increase the risks through cross-agent contamination and broader attack surfaces. In this paper, we evaluate prompt injection attacks against an LLM-based multi-agent robotic system, considering both direct injections into task instructions and indirect injections through perception modules. In our experiments across varying attack-goal complexities and injection strategies in both single-agent and multi-agent settings, we show that prompt injection can induce adversarial actions while reducing task completion. We find that attacks can propagate from one agent to others through shared prompt structures, with impacts varying depending on prompt composition and the targeted agent. We further analyze how architectural changes affect LLM queries and, consequently, the attack success. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study that systematically investigates prompt injection attacks in a multi-agent LLM-based robotic system.

title: Me and My Bot: What Users Talk About in AI Companion Communities on Reddit
summary: AI companion communities on platforms such as Reddit are widely characterized as spaces where users discuss their relationships with AI bots. This study examines whether and how that characterization holds, guided by the Synthetic Resonance framework's claim that human-AI relationships can carry genuine relational meaning for the user. Multiple LLMs were employed to code 5,504 Reddit posts from eight AI companion communities for relationship focus, primary topic, and users' emotional valence. Although search terms were weighted toward relational and attachment language, only 45% of posts concerned the user's own relationship with their bot. Posts about users' own bots differed markedly from posts about bots in general in both topic and emotional expression, with 85% of general-bot posts containing no user emotion language compared to 33% of own-bot posts. Among the 970 posts that were relationally focused, companionship and romance each accounted for roughly 46% of discussion, sexual content for 8%, and emotional valence varied across these subtopics. The findings suggest that users engage with these relationships with AI bots as meaningful, and that the discourse about them is broad and emotionally complex.

title: A Protocol for Evaluating the Accessibility of AI-Generated Educational Materials: Prompt Configuration, WCAG-Derived Criteria, and Content Overload
summary: Generative AI tools increasingly produce educational materials: documents, slides, images, audio, and video, yet little is known about whether this content meets accessibility requirements. This paper presents a protocol for evaluating the accessibility of AI-generated educational materials against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), across five content types and multiple tools. The protocol compares three conditions applied to the same tool: a generic instruction with no accessibility language; a single prompt explicitly configured with WCAG criteria; and a persistent, reusable accessibility profile loaded once rather than re-specified each time. Evaluation combines a WCAG rubric per content type with heuristic validation by accessibility experts, addressing a known limitation of automated scanners. Prior evidence shows generative AI tools reproduce inaccessible practices by default, and that explicit configuration measurably improves compliance. This paper extends that discussion to a dimension WCAG checklists miss: visual and informational overload common in AI-synthesized content. The main contribution is methodological: a reproducible protocol and open evaluation instrument, with cases documenting the barriers non-configured AI content creates for people with disabilities. A first exploratory application is also reported: a rubric-based compliance score rose from a pooled mean of 24.2% under the generic condition to 96.7% under the WCAG-configured condition, using one model, one artifact per condition and type, and single-evaluator scoring; the persistent-profile condition was not exercised. The protocol is a reusable resource for the community to apply and extend at full benchmark scale. Beyond the protocol, this work aims to raise awareness of accessibility obstacles generative AI can introduce, and encourage creators to consider accessibility when using these tools.

title: Hierarchical Residual Policy Optimization for Generative Recommendations
comments: 12 pages, 6 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at KDD 2026 Research Track
summary: Generative recommenders select items by autoregressively decoding semantic identifiers (SIDs), whose token positions induce a coarse-to-fine hierarchy over the item space. In practice, SID decoders are trained via supervised next-token prediction, which imitates logged trajectories rather than directly optimizing downstream utility. This motivates post-training with outcome feedback to guide decoding toward higher utility. However, logged feedback is only observed for the final exposed item, causing most post-training methods to operate at the item level and broadcast the same terminal signal across all SID tokens. As a result, token-level credit assignment becomes sparse, high-variance, and layer-dependent. To this end, we propose Hierarchical Residual Policy Optimization (HRPO), a post-training framework that converts item-level outcomes into dense, token-aligned learning signals for conservative token-wise improvement. Specifically, HRPO first estimates SID prefix-level utilities via group-wise reward smoothing over feature-based user clusters. It then decomposes these utilities into residual token credits and accumulates them into credit-to-go signals. Finally, Residual-Return Policy Optimization (RRPO) optimizes the residual credits using clipped updates, group-normalized advantages, and KL regularization to preserve stability. Experiments on a public dataset and an online A/B test in a large-scale commercial system show consistent gains in session-level utility and key business metrics. Source code and the archived artifact are available for reproduction.
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at KDD 2026 Research Track

title: NISF++: Geometrically-grounded implicit representations of 3D+time cardiac function from 2D short- and long-axis MR views
summary: Clinical acquisition in cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging involves obtaining cross-sectional planes of the heart along the radial and longitudinal directions. Despite these planes being 2D cross-sectional images of the heart, radiologists understand the 3D spatial and continuous temporal nature of the organ being imaged. The same can not be said about the conventional deep learning architectures used to process CMR images, which rely on in-plane and grid-based operations, and are hence unable to organically integrate information from all imaging planes. This paper builds upon previous work on neural implicit segmentation functions (NISF) to overcome unaddressed challenges in cardiac function modeling in the CMR domain. For a given subject, our architecture builds a shared 3D+time representations from all available acquisition planes regardless of orientation. By design, predictions along any imaging plane orientation are cross-sections of the same 3D representation, leading to spatio-temporal consistency across all slices. Moreover, our architecture makes the rotation and translation parameters of imaging planes learnable, allowing us to correct for the commonplace respiratory and patient motion between slice acquisitions under a rigid assumption. Furthermore, interpolation of intensities and segmentation can be performed in 4D at any desired resolution. We perform our study on a 120 subject sub-cohort of CMR imaging data from the UK-Biobank. Our in-plane segmentation performance is on-par with existing CMR segmentation methods and explore how the majority of failure cases arise from limitations in the ground-truth segmentation, for which our representations make predictions with better anatomical accuracy than its original training data. We also evaluate our motion-correction capabilities, displaying quantitative and qualitative improvements in slice alignment.

title: CN101 - A Digital Thermodynamic Computer for Generative AI
summary: Thermodynamic computing is an emerging hardware paradigm, in which stochastic physical dynamics serve as the direct computational primitive. The recent explosion of generative AI has only sharpened the search for alternative approaches to compute, and, as we show in this work, thermodynamic computing turns out to be well suited to this space. An important class of methods realises a function as the stationary expectation of an ergodic stochastic process: the answer is encoded in the time-averaged statistics of an equilibrating trajectory. To date, this equilibration-style class has been formulated exclusively through Langevin dynamics, restricting its implementations to analogue substrates and the engineering challenges those bring. In this work, we propose a substrate-independent formalisation of the equilibration-style formulation, in which the only object of design is the dynamical generator L* of an arbitrary ergodic process. The formalisation makes three hardware-level properties of the formulation explicit: the precision of a result is a knob set by how long the dynamics are run, sample averages decompose across independent trajectories, and dependent stages of a computation operate concurrently rather than serially, a property we call sequential parallelism. We instantiate the formalisation by fabricating a prototype digital thermodynamic computing chip, named CN101, that implements the formulation through discrete accumulator dynamics on standard CMOS using stochastic computing principles. We characterise CN101's success across conventional generative AI workloads in the form of VAEs and flow matching, applied to both image generation and scientific problems. Together, the formalisation and its digital instantiation show that the equilibration-style formulation is substrate-independent, and that its computational properties can be exploited on standard digital hardware.

title: Impedance Control via Generalized Output Regulation
summary: Achieving a desired impedance during physical interaction remains a central problem in compliant control. In many practical implementations, admittance control combined with linear position controllers is employed, but this structure typically results in only approximate impedance behavior. This paper establishes a rigorous equivalence between the impedance realization problem and the generalized output regulation theory, and shows that, under the admittance architecture and assuming the inner position controller is restricted to linear combinations of commonly used signals, a unique control law exists that achieves exact compliant control. The resulting controller introduces additional terms with respect to a conventional PD formulation, while preserving a simple structure. Numerical simulations are used to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach under nominal conditions and in the presence of model uncertainties, and to compare its performance against a standard PD controller. The results demonstrate improved interaction performance and robustness, supporting the theoretical analysis.

title: Less Is More: Tuning Configurable Systems with Imperfect Fidelity
comments: Accepted by the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
summary: Configuration tuning is essential for optimizing the performance of highly configurable systems, e.g., throughput or runtime, under a given environment. Yet, this is a challenging process as there can be many options to tune, and configuration measurement is often highly expensive. In this paper, we demonstrate the phenomenon of ``less can be more'': system configuration tuning can be greatly improved with much superior budget utilization by partially tuning under the imperfect-fidelity---an environment that is similar, but cheaper to measure, compared with the concerned perfect-fidelity of environment under which the system should be tuned. We codify a conceptual framework of fidelity for configurable systems, drawing on which allows us to propose MFTune, a tuner that proactively explores in the space of $>10^4$ possible imperfect-fidelity settings to approximate a useful one, which strikes for the wideness of tuning. This creates high-quality seeds for the perfect-fidelity, which in turn ensures the tuning depth. Experiment results against $10$ state-of-the-art tuners, obtained from running diverse real-world systems for $19$ months $24 \times 7$, show that MFTune performs considerably better on $83.33$\% cases with up to $19.34\%$ improvement while achieving hours of budget saving in general.
comment: Accepted by the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)

title: Variational Inference Using a Differentiable Multigrid Linear Solver
summary: Gradient-based Bayesian inference methods require efficient access to Jacobian and adjoint-Jacobian operators of high-dimensional forward models. While multigrid solvers provide near-optimal complexity for elliptic partial differential equations, they are rarely available in forms compatible with automatic differentiation (AD). We develop a differentiable multigrid solver for steady-state diffusion-absorption problems and derive its adjoint operations analytically through the full multigrid hierarchy. The resulting solver, DMGS, is implemented in C++ and interfaced with JAX to provide efficient Jacobian-vector and vector-Jacobian products for variational inference in the NIFTy framework. We validate the approach on a 3D inverse problem involving diffuse radiative transfer in tissue, reconstructing an effective radiative source from Monte Carlo-simulated data. The reconstruction reproduces the data at a reduced chi-squared of 1.1 and generalizes to 32 independent validation datasets. Benchmarks against a JAX-native multigrid implementation show comparable runtimes and consistently lower peak memory for the hand-derived adjoint, with modest reverse-mode overhead. These results establish differentiable multigrid solvers as practical building blocks for variational inference in PDE-constrained problems.

title: An Analysis of Brent's Insertion Method for Hash Tables
summary:
In 1968, Richard P.~Brent introduced a new way of building a hash table that, at least empirically, achieves a remarkable property: Even if the hash table is filled to 100\% full, the expected time to query a \emph{random key out of those present} is $O(1)$.
  Despite the simplicity of Brent's method, the guarantees of the method have never been formally analyzed. This is due to the subtle issue of handling \emph{spoiled randomness}. The algorithm will sometimes try to use hash functions $h_j$ on keys $y$ that it has already probed in the past. When the algorithm does this, we cannot treat the hash function as random, because its random bits have already affected the state of the table. This issue makes Brent's method surprisingly subtle to reason about formally.
  In this note, we give a simple and formal analysis of Brent's hash table. The analysis can be taught in a graduate randomized algorithms course, and provides a nice example of how to deal with subtle issues in a probabilistic analysis (namely, the issue of spoiled randomness).

title: Continuous Face Authentication on Mobile and Desktop Platforms: A Comparative Study
summary: Personal devices hold sensitive data and provide access to sensitive services. Conventional personal device authentication verifies users' identity only at the moment access is granted. An unlocked device may be accessed by an unauthorized person if the user stops using the device without locking it, or if another person takes over. Continuous authentication addresses this gap. This paper investigates how device type and usage conditions influence continuous mobile face authentication with an InsightFace-based approach with temporal trust decay. We evaluate the approach with mobile and desktop recordings with different head directions and lighting conditions. We also evaluate recordings from everyday mobile device use without predefined tasks. The results show that device type alone has little impact, while different usage conditions do have impact on the authentication performance. Results also show that everyday mobile device use is in general more challenging for continuous face authentication, where reduced face visibility, including occlusions and faces outside the camera viewport, is a main contributor to false rejections.

title: FinDeepIndicator: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents in End-to-End Financial Indicator Construction
summary: Financial indicators are essential tools for transforming raw financial data into interpretable measures for various downstream tasks, such as valuation, risk assessment, and economic analysis. However, existing financial benchmarks largely focus on answer-level accuracy and often assume that relevant data are already provided, leaving the assessment of the intermediate process of indicator construction underexplored. In this work, we propose FinDeepIndicator, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating Deep Research (DR) agents in end-to-end financial indicator construction. Specifically, FinDeepIndicator evaluates DR agents across four stages in indicator construction: formula specification, data collection, indicator calculation, and answer generation, and covers fundamental, technical, and macroeconomic indicators organized into 21 fine-grained sub-categories. It contains 3,350 curated question-answer (QA) pairs derived from both U.S. and Chinese markets, 10 years of historical financial data, and 800 listed companies. Extensive experiments on search-equipped Large Language Models (LLMs) and DR agents show that, while LLMs generally perform well in formula specification, their accuracy drops substantially during data retrieval and numerical execution. DR agents consistently outperform search-equipped LLMs, yet remain unreliable in realistic financial analysis settings. These findings provide insights for developing more capable and trustworthy DR agents in finance.

title: RAGOCR: Optical Compression of Retrieval-Augmented Text via Visual Representation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become essential for knowledge-intensive question answering, yet scaling RAG pipelines remains challenging due to the prohibitive computational cost of processing lengthy retrieved contexts. Existing compression approaches face a fundamental trade-off: hard compression methods operate online in a query-aware fashion but achieve only modest compression rates and typically require fine-tuning the generative model, while soft compression methods attain higher ratios but rely on costly offline encoding that is entirely agnostic to the input query. To bridge this gap, we introduce RAGOCR, a novel framework that compresses retrieved documents into compact visual representations conditioned on the input query. To further balance compression rate and information fidelity, we introduce a query-aware dynamic resolution mechanism that adaptively allocates visual granularity based on each document's estimated relevance and complexity: highly relevant passages are rendered at higher resolution to preserve fine-grained details, while peripheral documents are aggressively compressed at lower resolution. Experiments on five QA benchmarks using the MedOmniKB retrieval corpus demonstrate that RAGOCR surpasses naive RAG by over 15\% in accuracy while requiring only one-eighth the number of input tokens, and consistently outperforms both hard and soft compression baselines across varying retrieval depths.

title: Hi-TOPS: Hierarchical Topology-aware Scoring Prior for 3D Part Decomposition
summary: Accurate 3D part decomposition requires separating shapes into structurally meaningful components with precise boundaries while preserving articulation seams and thin attachments. Existing approaches often suffer from a structural-scale mismatch: geometric evidence for separation is most reliable at the meso scale, yet many pipelines operate either too globally to respect joints or too locally to remain robust to noise. We propose Hi-TOPS, a Hierarchical Topology-aware Scoring Prior that aggregates complementary intrinsic cues into a multi-resolution Flow-Freeze field. Flow regions provide expandable support for primitive coverage, while Freeze regions restrict growth near articulations and thin structures. A TSDF-guided body-surface superquadric fitter then captures dominant cores and residual surface structures, followed by SQ-to-mesh assignment for connected, boundary-aligned parts. Across diverse benchmarks, Hi-TOPS delivers stable, editable decompositions without semantic supervision or 2D foundation priors.

title: Taming the Search Space: Solving and Generating Hitori and Binairo Puzzles
summary: This paper investigates solving and generation techniques for the logic puzzles Hitori and Binairo. Two solving paradigms are compared: backtracking with domain-specific optimizations, and SAT-based solving via conjunctive normal form encodings. An empirical evaluation analyzes runtime, explored search nodes, and branching factor across varying puzzle sizes. To support systematic benchmarking in the evaluation, generators capable of producing valid and uniquely solvable puzzle instances are developed. Results indicate that constraint propagation is the most effective backtracking optimization, substantially reducing the effective branching factor, search tree size, and thus runtime. Heuristic variable ordering and scoring strategies provide additional improvements. For Binairo, the SAT-based approach solves all evaluated instances within low runtime, while optimized backtracking fails to solve difficult puzzle instances within the timeout. For Hitori, propagation-based backtracking achieves the best results, while for the SAT-based approach the iterative connectivity check takes up the majority of the runtime, failing difficult puzzle instances.

title: ChordVideo: One-Step, Training-Free, Temporally Consistent Video Editing via Low-Energy Transport
summary: One-step text-to-image models enable training-free, inversion-free editing with only 1--2 network function evaluations (NFE), while ChordEdit stabilizes such edits through low-energy smoothing along sampling time. Applied independently to video frames, however, it produces temporal flicker and edit-strength drift. We introduce \textbf{ChordVideo}, which extends the same low-energy principle to video time through shared noise, motion-aligned causal aggregation of per-frame Chord fields, and an optional temporally smoothed proximal correction. We derive a warping-error bound that separates motion bias from stochastic flicker and predicts diminishing returns with larger temporal windows. On TGVE/DAVIS with two one-step backbones, ChordVideo reduces warping error by \textbf{78\%} and flicker by \textbf{49\%}, improves CLIP frame consistency by \textbf{9--10 points}, and increases background PSNR by about \textbf{1.5,dB}, while retaining \textbf{2 NFE/frame}. Compared with seven multi-step editors, it achieves competitive temporal consistency and source preservation using \textbf{10--60$\times$ fewer model steps per clip

AI.title_translation: ChordVideo：通过低能量传输实现一步、免训练、时间一致的视频编辑
AI.tldr: ChordVideo将低能量平滑原则引入视频时间轴，以每帧仅需2 NFE的极低计算成本，实现了高效、免训练且时间一致的视频编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有的单步文本到图像模型虽能实现快速免训练编辑，但若将针对图像的低能量平滑编辑方法（如ChordEdit）直接独立应用于视频各帧，会导致严重的时间闪烁（temporal flicker）和编辑强度漂移（edit-strength drift）。
AI.method: 提出了ChordVideo方法，将低能量传输原则扩展至视频时间域。主要技术包括：1）共享噪声；2）对每帧Chord场进行基于运动对齐的因果聚合；3）可选的时间平滑近端校正（proximal correction）。此外，论文还推导了区分运动偏差与随机闪烁的变形误差界限（warping-error bound）。
AI.result: 在TGVE和DAVIS数据集上使用两种单步骨干网络评估，ChordVideo使变形误差降低了78%，闪烁减少了49%，CLIP帧一致性提高了9-10分，背景PSNR提升约1.5 dB，同时保持每帧仅需2 NFE。相比7种多步视频编辑方法，单视频剪辑的模型步数减少了10-60倍，同时保持了强竞争力的时间一致性和原视频背景保持能力。
AI.conclusion: ChordVideo成功地在单步生成模型的基础上实现了高效、高质且时间一致的免训练视频编辑，以极低计算成本（每帧2 NFE）达到了与多步编辑方法相当甚至更好的编辑效果。
AI.translation: 单步文本生成图像模型仅需1-2次网络功能评估（NFE）即可实现无需训练和反演的编辑，而ChordEdit通过沿着采样时间的低能量平滑稳定了此类编辑。然而，若将该方法独立应用于视频帧，会产生时间闪烁和编辑强度漂移。我们提出了ChordVideo，通过共享噪声、对每帧Chord场进行基于运动对齐的因果聚合，以及可选的时间平滑近端校正，将相同的低能量原则扩展到视频时间维度。我们推导了一个变形误差界限，将运动偏差与随机闪烁区分开来，并预测了较长时间窗口下收益递减的情况。在包含两个单步骨干网络的TGVE/DAVIS数据集上，ChordVideo将变形误差降低了78%，闪烁降低了49%，CLIP帧一致性提高了9-10分，背景PSNR提高了约1.5 dB，同时每帧保持2 NFE。与七种多步编辑方法相比，它每剪辑使用的模型步骤减少了10-60倍，同时获得了极具竞争力的时间一致性和源视频保持能力。
AI.summary: 针对单步图像编辑直接应用到视频时出现的帧间闪烁和编辑漂移问题，ChordVideo通过共享噪声、基于运动对齐的因果聚合及时间近端校正，将低能量传输扩展到视频时间轴。在每帧仅需2 NFE极低开销下，大幅提升了视频编辑的时间一致性与背景保持能力，计算效率比传统多步编辑提升10-60倍。
AI.keywords: 视频编辑, 单步生成模型, 时间一致性, 低能量传输, 免训练
AI.comments:
创新性：论文巧妙地将单步图像编辑中的低能量平滑原则拓展至视频时间域，结合运动对齐因果聚合和理论误差界限推导，实现了高效的时间一致性控制。
重要性：将视频编辑的计算开销降低了10-60倍（每帧仅需2 NFE），显著提升了免训练视频编辑的应用价值和实用效率。
局限性：理论推导表明大时间窗口下存在收益递减效应，且依赖运动对齐，在面对极度剧烈或复杂非刚性运动场景时的表现仍需进一步验证。

title: ORCESTRA: VLM-driven Visual Robot programming in Mixed Reality
summary: ORCESTRA is a mixed-reality system for programming robot digital twins through no-code waypoint teaching and language-guided control. In a passthrough mixed-reality workspace, users place robot twins on real surfaces, teach trajectories, save robot-relative episodes, or issue spoken/typed commands that a vision-language model converts into structured digital-twin plans. Both interaction modes share a backend for metric grounding, embodiment-aware validation, preview, confirmation, and digital-twin execution. The system supports heterogeneous robot embodiments, including fixed-base manipulators, a mobile base, and a humanoid robot, demonstrating MR validation as a safety layer for language-guided robot programming before physical deployment.

AI.title_translation: ORCESTRA：混合现实中基于视觉语言模型驱动的视觉机器人编程
AI.tldr: ORCESTRA 利用混合现实与视觉语言模型，通过无代码教学和语言指令实现异构机器人数字孪生的安全编程与预览。
AI.motivation: 旨在简化机器人编程流程，并解决语言引导的机器人控制在物理部署前缺乏直观安全验证和多具身适配的问题。
AI.method: 结合透视混合现实工作空间与视觉语言模型（VLM），支持无代码路标轨迹教学以及自然语言指令控制。系统共享统一后端，执行度量接地、具身感知验证、动作预览、确认及数字孪生运行。
AI.result: 成功支持了包括固定底座机械臂、移动底座和人形机器人在内的多种异构机器人具身编程与验证。
AI.conclusion: 混合现实（MR）验证可以作为语言引导机器人编程在物理部署前的有效安全层。
AI.translation: ORCESTRA 是一个混合现实系统，用于通过无代码路标教学和语言引导控制对机器人数字孪生进行编程。在透视混合现实工作空间中，用户将机器人孪生体放置在真实表面上，教授运动轨迹，保存机器人相对情景，或发出口头/键入的指令，视觉语言模型（VLM）将这些指令转换为结构化的数字孪生计划。两种交互模式共享一个后端，用于度量接地、具身感知验证、预览、确认和数字孪生执行。该系统支持包括固定底座机械臂、移动底座和人形机器人在内的异构机器人具身，证明了 MR 验证在物理部署前作为语言引导机器人编程安全层的有效性。
AI.summary: ORCESTRA 结合了混合现实与视觉语言模型（VLM），提供无代码轨迹示教与自然语言控制两种模式，为异构机器人数字孪生提供直观编程、安全预览及动作执行。
AI.keywords: 混合现实, 机器人编程, 视觉语言模型, 数字孪生, 具身验证
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将透视混合现实（MR）与视觉语言模型（VLM）结合，把数字孪生作为机器人物理部署前的安全中间层，大幅降低了机器人编程门槛并提高了安全性。其对异构机器人（包含人形机器人）的泛化能力具有重要现实意义。局限性在于摘要未具体说明物理机器人的实际部署效果及系统延迟。

title: Generic Vision and Cross-Attention for Reaction Yield Prediction
summary: Traditional reaction yield prediction is constrained by 1D quantum descriptors that lack explicit spatial information. To address this gap, a dual-modal Vision Cross-Attention architecture is proposed, fusing tabular physical-organic data with 2D molecular topologies. Notably, it is demonstrated that a generic computer vision backbone processing simple 2D skeletal structures independently outperforms purely quantum-based baselines. By synergizing both modalities, superior predictive accuracy compared to traditional methodologies is achieved by the optimal cross-attention framework (Test RMSE = 5.27%). Through mechanistic probing, active, descriptor-guided spatial querying is observed, effectively offloading macroscopic steric identification to the visual pathway. Furthermore, a dynamic chemical hierarchy is learned by the network to heavily prioritize critical steric bottlenecks, such as the aryl halide. Concurrently, residual skip connections are utilized to protect non-spatial electronic parameters from destructive attenuation during fusion. Collectively, a scalable and highly interpretable blueprint is provided for augmenting physical chemistry with deep visual learning.

AI.title_translation: 用于化学反应产率预测的通用计算机视觉与交叉注意力机制
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种融合2D分子图像与物理有机描述符的双模态交叉注意力模型，成功提升了反应产率预测精度（RMSE为5.27%）并具备强可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统化学反应产率预测方法过度依赖1D量子描述符，缺乏显式的三维/空间物理信息，限制了模型对立体阻碍等空间效应的捕获能力。
AI.method: 提出了一个双模态Vision Cross-Attention（视觉交叉注意力）架构，将表格化的物理有机数据与2D分子拓扑结构图像相结合。使用通用计算机视觉骨干网络提取2D骨架图像的空间特征，并通过交叉注意力机制与1D物理化学描述符进行深度融合，同时利用残差跳跃连接保护非空间电子参数。
AI.result: 单纯使用通用CV骨干处理2D骨架结构的效果即超越了纯量子描述符基线；最优的交叉注意力融合模型取得了最高的预测精度（测试集 RMSE = 5.27%）。可解释性分析表明网络能动态关注关键立体位阻瓶颈（如芳基卤化物），并有效分担了宏观立体阻碍识别任务。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功证明了结合2D分子拓扑图像与表格化物理有机描述符的双模态交叉注意力架构在反应产率预测中的优越性，为利用深度视觉学习增强物理化学研究提供了一个具备可扩展性和高可解释性的蓝图。
AI.translation: 传统化学反应产率预测受限于缺乏显式空间信息的一维量子描述符。为了弥补这一空白，本文提出了一种双模态视觉交叉注意力（Vision Cross-Attention）架构，将表格化物理有机数据与二维分子拓扑结构相结合。值得注意的是，实验证明仅使用通用计算机视觉骨干网络处理简单的二维骨架结构，其表现就独立超越了纯基于量子的基线方法。通过协同这两种模态，最佳的交叉注意力框架取得了比传统方法更优异的预测精度（测试集RMSE = 5.27%）。通过机理探针分析，观察到了以描述符为引导的活性空间查询，有效地将宏观立体阻碍的识别分担给了视觉通路。此外，网络学习到了动态化学层级结构，从而高度优先处理关键的立体位阻瓶颈（如芳基卤化物）。同时，利用残差跳跃连接保护非空间电子参数在融合过程中免受破坏性衰减。总的来说，本研究为利用深度视觉学习增强物理化学研究提供了一个具备可扩展性和高可解释性的蓝图。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种结合通用计算机视觉与交叉注意力机制的双模态反应产率预测方法。该方法将2D分子拓扑图像与表格化物理有机描述符相融合，仅通过2D骨架图像即可超越传统的1D量子描述符基线，最终融合模型达到了5.27%的测试集RMSE。此外，模型通过自适应空间查询和残差连接展示出极高的化学可解释性。
AI.keywords: 反应产率预测, 计算机视觉, 交叉注意力机制, 双模态融合, 可解释性AI
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地将通用计算机视觉模型引入化学反应产率预测领域，证明了简单的2D分子骨架图像比复杂的1D量子描述符能够提供更丰富的空间/立体阻碍信息。结合交叉注意力机制与残差跳跃连接，不仅显著提升了预测精度（RMSE达到5.27%），还赋予了模型高度的可解释性，为AI驱动的化学研究（AI for Science）提供了新颖且有活力的思路。

title: SIPTraj: Map-Free End-to-End Trajectory Prediction via Physics-Guided Scene Interaction
summary: Trajectory prediction of surrounding agents is a prerequisite for safe planning and decision making in autonomous driving. Without high-definition (HD) maps, sensor-derived bird's-eye-view (BEV) features provide no explicit lane topology or drivable-area priors, making it inherently difficult to ground each agent in its surrounding scene context. Moreover, physical feasibility remains difficult to capture through data-driven learning alone, as kinematic constraints on agent motion cannot be explicitly encoded without structured supervision. Existing map-free predictors extract scene context in an agent-agnostic manner through a single fusion step and treat physical constraints only as output-level penalties, leaving both challenges unaddressed. We propose SIPTraj, a map-free trajectory prediction framework that jointly addresses scene grounding and physical feasibility. SIPTraj introduces a Hierarchical Agent-Scene Encoder (HASE) progressively grounding each agent in agent-guided scene evidence and refining inter-agent relations within the scene-grounded space. To tackle physical infeasibility in predicted trajectories, we develop a Physics-Guided Iterative Decoder (PGID). It conditions decoding on instantaneous kinematic states, propagating physical supervision into internal representations rather than output trajectories alone. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 Sensor show that SIPTraj surpasses prior map-free predictors and strong map-based baselines without any HD map at inference. Our code will be released as open-source.

AI.title_translation: SIPTraj：通过物理引导场景交互实现的无地图端到端轨迹预测
AI.tldr: SIPTraj是一个无地图轨迹预测框架，通过分级智能体-场景编码和物理引导迭代解码，有效解决了无地图场景下的场景定位与轨迹物理可行性难题。
AI.motivation: 无地图轨迹预测缺乏高精地图提供的车道拓扑和可行驶区域先验，导致智能体难以精准定位到周围场景中；同时纯数据驱动方法缺乏显式运动学约束，生成的预测轨迹容易违背物理可行性。现有方法未能在表征层面有效解决这两大挑战。
AI.method: 提出了SIPTraj无地图轨迹预测框架，包含两个核心模块：1）分级智能体-场景编码器（HASE）：以智能体为引导逐步提取场景证据，并在场景定位空间内优化智能体间的交互关系；2）物理引导迭代解码器（PGID）：以瞬时运动学状态为条件进行解码，将物理监督直接传播到内部特征表征中。
AI.result: 在nuScenes和Argoverse 2 Sensor数据集上的实验表明，SIPTraj在推理阶段无需任何高精地图，性能超越了以往的无地图预测方法以及强力的基于高精地图的基线模型。
AI.conclusion: SIPTraj成功联合解决了无地图轨迹预测中的场景定位与物理可行性难题，证明了通过物理引导和渐进式场景交互可以在无需高精地图的前提下实现甚至超越基于地图方法的预测精度。
AI.translation: 周围智能体的轨迹预测是自动驾驶中安全规划和决策的前提。在没有高精（HD）地图的情况下，基于传感器衍生的鸟瞰图（BEV）特征无法提供明确的车道拓扑或可行驶区域先验，这使得将每个智能体定位到其周围场景上下文中变得固有地困难。此外，由于在没有结构化监督的情况下无法显式编码智能体运动的运动学约束，仅靠数据驱动的学习仍难以捕捉物理可行性。现有的无地图预测器通过单步融合以智能体无关的方式提取场景上下文，并将物理约束仅视为输出层面的惩罚，导致这两个挑战都未得到解决。我们提出了 SIPTraj，这是一个联合解决场景定位和物理可行性的无地图轨迹预测框架。SIPTraj 引入了分级智能体-场景编码器（HASE），逐步将每个智能体定位在智能体引导的场景证据中，并在场景定位空间内精细化智能体间的关系。为了解决预测轨迹中的物理不可行性问题，我们开发了物理引导迭代解码器（PGID）。它以瞬时运动学状态为条件进行解码，将物理监督传播到内部表征中，而不是仅仅施加于输出轨迹。在 nuScenes 和 Argoverse 2 Sensor 上的广泛实验表明，SIPTraj 在推理时无需任何高精地图，超越了以往的无地图预测器和强力的基于地图的基线的性能。我们的代码将开源。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SIPTraj，一种基于物理引导场景交互的无地图端到端轨迹预测框架。该框架通过分级智能体-场景编码器（HASE）改善智能体在场景中的定位，并结合物理引导迭代解码器（PGID）将物理运动学约束引入解码器内部表征，有效解决了无地图预测中的场景融合和物理不可行性问题，在多个主流数据集上取得了领先性能。
AI.keywords: 轨迹预测, 无地图, 物理引导, 场景定位, 自动驾驶
AI.comments: 本文创新性地解决了无地图轨迹预测中的两大核心痛点（场景定位与物理约束）。其突出亮点在于将物理运动学约束深入引入到解码器的内部表征中，而非仅停留在输出层的惩罚；同时提出了分级编码机制以改善智能体与场景上下文的结合。局限在于具体的物理运动学模型及其计算开销在摘要中尚未展开，实际实时部署表现有待进一步验证。

title: Distill Where You Fail: Recovering Learning Signals of Negative RL-Groups from Adaptive Teacher Guidance
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs). While Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely adopted, it suffers from sparse reward signals and loses gradients entirely when all responses within a group receive identical rewards. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a natural remedy by providing dense, token-level supervision from a teacher model. However, naively combining GRPO with OPD leads to degraded performance, due to three underlying causes: not all samples benefit from distillation; fitting too quickly to the teacher undermines the exploratory capacity of RL; and OPD's advantages are asymmetric, suppressing most tokens. To address these challenges, we propose RSTG (Recovering Learning Signals via Adaptive Teacher Guidance), which applies distillation selectively and precisely where it matters most. At the sample level, OPD is restricted to negative zero-variance prompts with each sample weighted by the teacher's confidence score. At the token level, distillation targets only tokens with high student entropy or large teacher-student divergence. We further augment training with SFT on correct trajectories generated by the teacher model, injecting positive gradient signals where RL yields none. Experiments demonstrate that RSTG substantially outperforms naive GRPO+OPD by +4.02% on math and +3.05% on code.

AI.title_translation: 蒸馏于失败处：通过自适应教师指导恢复负RL组的学习信号
AI.tldr: 本文提出RSTG方法，通过在样本和Token级别进行自适应蒸馏并补充教师正确轨迹的SFT，解决了GRPO强化学习中负零方差组梯度缺失及与蒸馏结合效果不佳的问题。
AI.motivation: 在基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，GRPO存在奖励信号稀疏以及组内响应奖励相同（如全错的零方差组）时丢失梯度的问题。虽然On-policy蒸馏（OPD）能提供密集监督，但直接将GRPO与OPD结合会导致性能下降，原因包括并非所有样本适合蒸馏、过快拟合教师会损害RL探索能力，以及OPD的优势不对称性导致大部分Token被抑制。
AI.method: 提出了RSTG（ Recovering Learning Signals via Adaptive Teacher Guidance）方法：1. 样本级选择性蒸馏：仅在负零方差提示上应用OPD，并根据教师模型的置信度得分进行加权；2. Token级精准蒸馏：仅针对学生模型熵较高或教师-学生分歧较大的Token进行蒸馏；3. 正信号注入：结合教师模型生成的正确轨迹进行SFT增强训练，弥补RL无梯度信号的不足。
AI.result: 实验表明，RSTG在数学任务上比朴素的GRPO+OPD提升了4.02%，在代码任务上提升了3.05%。
AI.conclusion: RSTG通过自适应且选择性的教师指导以及选择性SFT，成功解决了GRPO结合On-policy蒸馏时的探索受损和信号缺失问题，大幅提升了大语言模型在推理任务上的性能。
AI.translation: 带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为大语言模型（LLM）后训练的标准范式。尽管组相对策略优化（GRPO）被广泛采用，但它面临奖励信号稀疏的问题，且当组内所有响应获得相同奖励时会完全丢失梯度。On-policy蒸馏（OPD）通过提供来自教师模型的密集Token级监督，提供了一种自然的补救方法。然而，简单地将GRPO与OPD结合会导致性能下降，原因有三个潜在因素：并非所有样本都能从蒸馏中获益；过快拟合教师模型会破坏RL的探索能力；以及OPD的优势具有不对称性，抑制了大多数Token。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了RSTG（通过自适应教师指导恢复学习信号），它在最关键的地方选择性且精准地应用蒸馏。在样本级别，OPD被限制在负零方差的提示上，每个样本由教师的置信度得分加权。在Token级别，蒸馏仅针对学生模型高熵或教师-学生分歧较大的Token。我们还通过教师模型生成的正确轨迹上的SFT来增强训练，在RL无法产生信号的地方注入正梯度信号。实验表明，RSTG在数学任务上比朴素的GRPO+OPD大幅提升了+4.02%，在代码任务上提升了+3.05%。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型强化学习中GRPO算法在负零方差组缺乏梯度信号以及直接结合On-policy蒸馏效果不佳的问题，提出了RSTG方法。该方法在样本层面仅对负零方差组按教师置信度蒸馏，在Token层面仅蒸馏高熵或高分歧Token，并利用教师正确轨迹进行SFT，显著提升了模型在数学和代码推理任务上的表现。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 强化学习, 组相对策略优化, 模型蒸馏, 自适应指导
AI.comments: 创新性：提出了样本级与Token级双重粒度的自适应蒸馏机制，有效解决了GRPO在负零方差组中梯度消失的问题。重要性：打破了GRPO与On-policy蒸馏简单结合导致性能下降的瓶颈，提升了大模型在数学和代码任务上的后训练效果。局限性：摘要中未提及引入教师模型及生成正确轨迹所带来的额外计算与采样开销。

title: Safety Invariants for Agents Orchestrating Irreversible State Transitions: A Four-Dimensional Formalism Evaluated on Public Ledgers
summary: Autonomous agents are increasingly asked to produce irreversible effects on external systems - transferring funds, writing to durable storage, actuating hardware. Existing agent frameworks (ReAct, Reflexion, MCP) optimize task success on benchmarks and give little attention to the safety of irreversible side-effects. We formalize one such setting, movement of value across public ledgers, as state transitions in a four-dimensional space indexed by (wallet, chain, address, protocol), and use that formalism to state and prove a guarantee we call execution fidelity: under a fault model admitting planner mis-mapping, ambiguous outcomes, retries, at-least-once delivery, and delegated non-human callers, a session's realized effect on the ledger is either nothing at all or exactly the transition that was rendered to the user, exactly once. The theorem deliberately does not claim that the rendered transition matches the user's intent - no runtime layer can decide that - but it confines that unbounded question to a single predicate over a finite object, which is what makes a preview a sufficient control rather than a formality. Seven safety invariants, derived from the fidelity condition rather than enumerated from experience, discharge the guarantee. Empirically, on a controlled N=60 adversarial suite the stack lifts pass rate by ~74 percentage points over a naive-ReAct baseline on two write-aggressive backing models, but by only ~3 points on a write-cautious one - evidence that single-model evaluations of agent safety stacks are close to unfalsifiable. The system is deployed; 108 production write operations across 8 chains back the failure taxonomy. Although the evaluation setting is public ledgers, the formalism and invariants apply to any probabilistic agent acting on irreversible external state.

AI.title_translation: 编排不可逆状态转移智能体的安全不变性：在公共账本上评估的四维形式化方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于约束智能体不可逆操作（如区块链转账）的形式化框架与七个安全不变性，确保实际执行效果与向用户展示的预览严格一致或完全不执行。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体框架（如ReAct、Reflexion、MCP等）主要关注于优化基准测试中的任务成功率，而忽视了智能体对外部系统产生不可逆副作用（如转账、写入持久化存储、驱动硬件）时的安全性问题。
AI.method: 将公共账本上的价值流动形式化为由（钱包、链、地址、协议）索引的四维空间中的状态转移，提出并证明了“执行保真度”保障（即对账本产生的实际效果要么为零，要么与向用户呈现的转移完全一致且仅执行一次），并由此推导出七个安全不变性。
AI.result: 在N=60的对抗测试集上，该框架在两个“积极写入”的基础模型上比原生ReAct基线提高了约74个百分点的通过率，但在“谨慎写入”模型上仅提高了约3个百分点；系统已上线部署，并在8条链上的108次生产环境写入操作中验证了失效分类法。
AI.conclusion: 单模型对智能体安全栈的评估容易产生误导。该形式化方法和安全不变性不仅适用于公共账本，还可推广至任何作用于不可逆外部状态的概率型智能体。
AI.translation: 自主智能体越来越多地被要求对外部系统产生不可逆的影响，例如转移资金、写入持久存储、驱动硬件。现有的智能体框架（ReAct、Reflexion、MCP）侧重于优化基准测试上的任务成功率，很少关注不可逆副作用的安全性。我们将这种场景之一——公共账本上的价值流动，形式化为由（钱包、链、地址、协议）构成的四维空间中的状态转移，并利用该形式化方法提出并证明了一种称为“执行保真度”的保证：在包含规划器错配、模糊结果、重试、至少一次交付以及委托非人类调用者的故障模型下，会话对账本产生的实际效果要么完全没有，要么与呈现给用户的转移完全一致且仅发生一次。该定理特意未主张呈现的转移符合用户的真实意图（没有任何运行时层能够决定这一点），但它将这个无界问题约束在一个有限对象上的单一谓词中，从而使预览成为一种充分的控制手段而非形式主义。从保真度条件中推导出的七个安全不变性（而非根据经验枚举）履行了这一保证。实证方面，在一个包含N=60的受控对抗性测试集上，该技术栈在两个“积极写入”的支撑模型上比原生ReAct基线提高了约74个百分点的通过率，但在一个“谨慎写入”的模型上仅提高了约3个百分点——这证明了对智能体安全栈进行单模型评估几乎是不可伪证的。该系统已部署；跨8条链的108次生产环境写入操作支持了该失效分类法。尽管评估场景是公共账本，但该形式化方法和不变性适用于任何作用于不可逆外部状态的概率型智能体。
AI.summary: 本研究针对智能体编排不可逆状态转移的安全性问题，提出了基于（钱包、链、地址、协议）四维空间的形式化方法与执行保真度保障，推导了七个安全不变性，并在公共账本及真实生产环境中验证了该方法的有效性与通用性。
AI.keywords: 智能体安全, 不可逆状态转移, 执行保真度, 公共账本, 安全不变性
AI.comments: 该论文提出了针对具有不可逆副作用（如资金转账、硬件驱动等）的AI智能体的形式化安全保障机制，将安全问题约束为有限对象上的确切谓词，具有很强的理论严密性与工程实用价值。论文还揭示了智能体安全评估中“单模型评估几乎不可伪证”的重要洞察。局限性在于该机制依赖于向用户呈现预览（preview），无法解决用户自身意图与呈现内容不符的“意图误解”源头问题。

title: HIERA: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Relevance Assessment for Content Discovery Systems
summary: Content discovery systems depend on relevance judgment for search quality evaluation, but human annotation faces inter-annotator disagreement and scaling costs. While Large Language Models show promise as automated assessors, current approaches rely on flat aggregation strategies: single-step prompting, voting ensembles, or uncoordinated multi-agent pipelines that aggregate independent outputs without integration. We propose HIERA, a hierarchical multi-agent relevance assessment framework with four specialized agents: a Relevance Judge, Query Analyzer, Item Analyzer, and Relation Analyzer. The Judge determines when specialist analysis is needed; the Relation Analyzer then coordinates query and item analyses with external knowledge to establish relevance relationships for final judgment. Ablation studies show that the same agents and external knowledge without hierarchical coordination degrade performance, confirming that the coordination structure itself accounts for the improvement. Evaluation across five datasets (EVS, MSRD, ESCI, WANDS, Home Depot) shows improvements over 11 baselines: 10.2\% on Home Depot, 4.8\% on ESCI, and up to 38\% on EVS ($p < 0.05$). Hierarchical coordination yields 12.7\% improvement over uncoordinated collaboration using identical agents.

AI.title_translation: HIERA：面向内容发现系统的分层多智能体相关性评估框架
AI.tldr: HIERA提出了包含四个专业智能体的分层协调框架，通过按需调用与外部知识整合显著提升了大模型在内容相关性评估上的准确性。
AI.motivation: 搜索与内容发现系统的人工相关性标注成本高且存在标注分歧，而基于LLM的现存自动评估方法多采用单步提示、投票集成或无协调的扁平多智能体管线，缺乏深度整合与协调。
AI.method: 提出了包含四个专业智能体的分层框架HIERA：相关性裁判负责判断何时需要专家分析；查询分析器与物品分析器提供细粒度解析；关系分析器则协调这两者并结合外部知识库建立相关性关系，最终输出判断结果。
AI.result: 在五个数据集上的评估显示，HIERA击败了11个基线模型（Home Depot提升10.2%，ESCI提升4.8%，EVS最高提升38%）。与使用相同智能体但无协调的方案相比，分层协调带来了12.7%的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: HIERA通过引入分层协调机制，显著提升了基于大语言模型的相关性评估质量，证明了合理的智能体组织架构比简单的扁平聚合更有助于解决复杂的相关性判断问题。
AI.translation: 内容发现系统依赖相关性判断来进行搜索质量评估，但人工标注面临标注者之间的分歧和扩展成本问题。虽然大语言模型在作为自动评估员方面展现出前景，但当前方法依赖于扁平的聚合策略：单步提示、投票集成或在没有整合的情况下聚合独立输出的无协调多智能体流水线。我们提出了HIERA，一种分层多智能体相关性评估框架，包含四个专门的智能体：相关性裁判、查询分析器、物品分析器和关系分析器。裁判智能体决定何时需要专家分析；关系分析器随后协调查询和物品分析并结合外部知识，以建立相关性关系用于最终判断。消融实验表明，在没有分层协调的情况下使用相同的智能体和外部知识会导致性能下降，证实了协调结构本身是性能提升的原因。在五个数据集（EVS、MSRD、ESCI、WANDS、Home Depot）上的评估表明，与11个基线相比有所提升：Home Depot提升10.2%，ESCI提升4.8%，EVS上最高提升38%（p < 0.05）。相比使用相同智能体的无协调协作，分层协调带来了12.7%的提升。
AI.summary: 本文针对搜索和内容发现系统中的相关性评估难题，提出了HIERA分层多智能体评估框架。该框架通过裁判、查询分析、物品分析和关系分析四个智能体的分层协作与外部知识融合，解决了传统LLM评估方法中扁平聚合缺乏集成的缺陷，在多个数据集上取得了显著优于传统基线和无协调多智能体方法的表现。
AI.keywords: 相关性评估, 多智能体系统, 大语言模型, 内容发现, 分层协调
AI.comments: 创新点在于打破了传统的独立多智能体输出扁平聚合模式，引入了基于相关性裁判按需调用的分层协调架构，并通过严谨的消融实验证明了协调结构本身带来的性能增益；局限性在于多智能体协作及外部知识库查询可能会增加推理时延与计算开销。

title: Order Auctions with Private Position Preferences
summary: We study auctions where two positions are sold to unit-demand bidders with private heterogeneous order preferences: some are specialists who value only the first position, while others are generalists who are indifferent between the two. First, we consider a standard first-price rule which allocates the first and second items to the highest and second-highest bidders, respectively. We show that no strategy profile ex-post implements the efficient allocation at every type profile, irrespective of payments, and provide a distribution-free equilibrium welfare guarantee of $\frac{1}{2}$. To augment this result, we prove that for deterministic one-round auctions and discrete bids, the efficient allocation requires each bidder to communicate at least one bit more than its bid's binary representation. We next ask what the same bit accomplishes in winner-pays-bid formats where bidders can also specify specific item preferences. In particular, we show that this strengthens our distribution-free equilibrium welfare guarantee to $1-\frac{1}{e}$. Finally, we discuss our results' applicability to priority service auctions and blockchain transaction sequencing.

AI.title_translation: 具有私有位置偏好的顺序拍卖
AI.tldr: 本文研究了私有位置偏好下的顺序拍卖，证明标准最高价拍卖福利保障仅为 1/2，而允许竞价者额外传递 1 比特偏好信息可将福利保障提升至 1 - 1/e。
AI.motivation: 探究在竞价者具有私有异质性位置偏好（如仅重视第一位置的专家与对两个位置无差异的通才）的环境下，顺序拍卖的效率损失与通信限制，并寻求通过改进信息表达机制来提升社会福利保障。
AI.method: 基于博弈论与机制设计理论，分析了标准最高价拍卖的均衡效率；推导了确定性单轮拍卖实现高效分配所需的通信复杂度下界；设计了允许竞价者额外指定具体物品偏好的“赢家按出价支付”拍卖规则。
AI.result: 1. 标准最高价规则无法事后实现高效分配，无分布均衡福利保障仅为 1/2；2. 实现高效分配要求每个竞价者比出价的二进制表示至少多传递 1 比特信息；3. 引入这 1 比特偏好表达后，赢家按出价支付格式的无分布均衡福利保障提升至 1 - 1/e。
AI.conclusion: 通过给出价人增加仅 1 比特的信息通信能力（指定具体偏好），可以显著提升具有私有位置偏好的顺序拍卖中的无分布均衡福利界限，该结论对优先级服务和区块链交易排序等场景有重要应用价值。
AI.translation: 我们研究了将两个位置出售给具有私有异质性顺序偏好的单需求竞价者的拍卖机制：其中一些是仅重视第一个位置的“专家”，而另一些是对两个位置无差异的“通才”。首先，我们考虑标准的最高价规则，该规则分别将第一和第二个物品分配给出价最高和次高的竞价者。我们证明，无论支付规则如何，都没有策略组合能在每个类型组合下事后实现高效分配，并提供了 1/2 的无分布均衡福利保障。为了补充这一结果，我们证明对于确定性单轮拍卖和离散出价，高效分配要求每个竞价者比其出价的二进制表示至少多通信 1 个比特。接着，我们探讨在允许竞价者指定特定物品偏好的“赢家按出价支付”格式中，这额外的 1 个比特能实现什么。特别地，我们证明这将其无分布均衡福利保障增强至 1 - 1/e。最后，我们讨论了我们的结果在优先级服务拍卖和区块链交易排序中的适用性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了向具有私有位置偏好的竞价者出售两个位置的拍卖机制。研究发现，传统的最高价拍卖机制无法保证高效分配且仅能提供 1/2 的福利保障。论文证明高效分配需要额外 1 比特的偏好信息表达，并进一步提出在机制中加入这 1 比特偏好声明可将福利保障提升至 1 - 1/e，为区块链交易排序等应用提供了理论依据。
AI.keywords: 顺序拍卖, 位置偏好, 通信复杂度, 福利保障, 区块链交易排序
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于结合了机制设计中的通信复杂度（Communication Complexity）与福利保障（Welfare Guarantees），揭示了仅仅 1 比特的偏好信息表达就能带来显著的福利保障提升（从 1/2 提升至 1 - 1/e）。这对于高频/低通信开销场景（如区块链 MEV 交易排序、优先级服务分发）具有极高的实用价值和理论指导意义。

title: StochSIPP: Safe Interval Path Planning in Stochastic Dynamic Environments
summary: Safe navigation under uncertain time-dependent blockage requires anticipating observations before committing to motion. We present StochSIPP, an exact contingent planner for temporal roadmaps with uncertain edge and vertex statuses revealed locally during execution. StochSIPP uses SIPP to generate certified-safe macro-actions that terminate at the next observation or the goal, and bounded AND/OR search over a cached action--observation graph to select actions for every reachable observation outcome. Optimistic and robust SIPP relaxations provide admissible lower and upper bounds for bounded AND/OR search. When every interval declared deterministically safe is truly safe, sensing is exact, and execution follows the planned timing, the resulting policy is provably collision-free. With correct independent probabilities and complete action and outcome generation, it minimizes expected arrival time within the roadmap and horizon. Experiments on controlled roadmap instances show that StochSIPP preserves the observed success of safe fixed-path baselines while reducing arrival time, and solves gated scenarios in which conservative fixed-path planners return no plan. A scalability study further reveals rapid growth as the number of simultaneously observed uncertain statuses increases.

AI.title_translation: StochSIPP：随机动态环境中的安全区间路径规划
AI.tldr: StochSIPP通过将SIPP与带界AND/OR搜索相结合，在不确定的随时间变化的动态环境中生成具有安全保证且期望到达时间最优的应急规划策略。
AI.motivation: 在随时间变化的阻塞不确定环境下进行安全导航，需要预测观察结果并提前制定策略，而现有保守的固定路径规划算法往往效率低下甚至在门控场景中无法给出可行的路径。
AI.method: 提出StochSIPP算法：结合SIPP生成在下一个观察点或目标点终止的保证安全的宏动作；构建缓存的动作-观察图；在图上使用带界的AND/OR搜索选择最佳动作；利用乐观和鲁棒的SIPP放松条件提供下界和上界估计。
AI.result: 实验表明，StochSIPP在保持安全固定路径基线成功率的同时显著减少了到达时间，并成功解决了保守路径规划器无解的门控场景；扩展性研究表明，其计算开销随同时观察的不确定状态数量增加而迅速增长。
AI.conclusion: 在满足安全区间准确、感知精确且执行定时的条件下，StochSIPP能提供理论上无碰撞且期望到达时间最小化的最优应急策略。
AI.translation: 在不确定的随时间变化的阻塞环境下进行安全导航，需要在做出运动承诺前预测观察结果。我们提出了StochSIPP，这是一种针对时空路线图的精确应急规划器，其中不确定的边和顶点状态会在执行过程中局部揭示。StochSIPP利用SIPP生成保证安全的宏动作（在下一个观察点或目标点终止），并在缓存的动作-观察图上使用带界的AND/OR搜索，为每个可达的观察结果选择动作。乐观和鲁棒的SIPP放松条件为带界的AND/OR搜索提供了可容许的下界和上界。当每个确定性声明安全的区间确实安全、感知精确且执行遵循计划时间时，生成的策略在证明上是无碰撞的。在具有正确的独立概率以及完整的动作和结果生成的情况下，它能最小化路线图和时界内的期望到达时间。在控制路线图实例上的实验表明，StochSIPP在减少到达时间的同时保持了安全固定路径基线的成功率，并解决了保守固定路径规划器无法提供计划的门控场景。一项可扩展性研究进一步揭示了随着同时观察到的不确定状态数量增加，其规模呈快速增长趋势。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了StochSIPP，一种用于随机动态环境中的精确应急路径规划器。它通过将SIPP与带界的AND/OR搜索结合，生成可以在执行过程中根据局部感知不确定状态灵活调整的策略。该算法在理论上保证碰撞自由并能最小化期望到达时间，在提高导航效率和求解门控复杂场景方面表现优异。
AI.keywords: 安全区间路径规划 (SIPP), 应急规划, 随机动态环境, AND/OR搜索, 不确定性导航
AI.comments:
创新性：将经典的SIPP（安全区间路径规划）扩展到随机动态环境，结合SIPP生成安全宏动作与AND/OR搜索进行应急规划，构思巧妙且理论严密。
优势：能在不确定性环境下保证碰撞自由（Provably Safe），同时最小化期望到达时间，有效解决了传统保守固定路径规划器在特定门控场景下无解的问题。
局限性：随着同时观察到的不确定状态数量增加，计算规模增长迅速，在极度复杂的多元不确定环境中可能面临可扩展性瓶颈。

title: DynamicWAM: Dual-Path Motion Conditioning for World-Action Models in Dynamic Manipulation
summary: Dynamic manipulation requires robots to infer target motion and respond promptly, yet existing World-Action Models (WAMs) typically condition only on the current frame and execute large backbones synchronously, limiting motion awareness and responsive control in dynamic scenes. We propose DynamicWAM, a compact WAM for dynamic object manipulation with dual-path motion conditioning. DynamicWAM introduces history-flow conditioning, encoding temporally aligned optical-flow frames alongside the current observation through a frozen pretrained video VAE to preserve spatial motion structure, while injecting kinematic descriptors of displacement, duration, velocity, and acceleration into the action expert to provide motion magnitude and timing. The two complementary paths are fused through joint world-action attention. A distilled compact backbone and real-time chunking (RTC)-based asynchronous execution further enable responsive control. On DOMINO, DynamicWAM achieves a 38.2% success rate and a 53.2 manipulation score, outperforming all evaluated baselines. Across 12 real-world tasks spanning linear, circular, and compound target motion, it achieves a 46.7% average success rate, exceeding the strongest baseline by 22.9 percentage points.

AI.title_translation: DynamicWAM：基于双路径运动条件约束的动态操作世界-动作模型
AI.tldr: DynamicWAM 结合历史光流与运动学描述符构成的双路径运动条件，并利用模型蒸馏与异步执行，实现了高效、高响应的机器人动态物体操作。
AI.motivation: 动态物体操作需要机器人能迅速推断目标运动并实时响应，但现有世界-动作模型（WAM）通常仅依赖当前单帧图像，且同步执行庞大的骨干网络，导致动态场景下的运动感知能力受限、控制响应迟钝。
AI.method: 提出了 DynamicWAM 框架，包含三大核心技术：1）双路径运动条件：历史光流条件路径通过预训练视频 VAE 编码时间对齐的光流帧以保留空间运动结构；物理运动学路径将位移、时长、速度和加速度描述符注入动作专家以提供运动幅度与定时；2）特征融合：通过联合世界-动作注意力机制（joint world-action attention）融合两条互补路径；3）实时响应：采用蒸馏后的紧凑骨干网络与基于实时分块（RTC）的异步执行机制。
AI.result: 在 DOMINO 仿真基准上，DynamicWAM 实现了 38.2% 的成功率和 53.2 的操作得分，优于所有对比基线；在包含直线、圆周及复合运动目标的 12 项真实世界动态操作任务中，取得了 46.7% 的平均成功率，超越最强基线 22.9 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: DynamicWAM通过双路径运动条件约束（视觉光流与物理运动学参数）以及轻量化异步执行架构，成功提升了机器人对动态目标的运动感知与即时响应控制能力，显著提高了动态操作的成功率。
