AI.title_translation: 线性时不变系统的最小执行器选择
AI.tldr: 本文研究了线性系统中最小执行器选择问题，旨在从给定执行器中选择最少数目以确保系统可控性。作者将该问题表征为整数线性规划或在特定条件下的集合多覆盖/集合覆盖问题。
AI.motivation: 选择少量可用执行器以确保线性系统的可控性是控制理论中的一个基本问题。以往的工作存在局限性，例如仅关注最优性能、简化可控性问题或在结构假设下进行，本文旨在推广这些方法以提供更精确的表征。
AI.method: 该问题被等效地表述为整数线性规划。如果驱动通道足够独立，则可表述为具有多重性约束的集合多覆盖问题；如果状态矩阵具有所有不同的特征值，则简化为集合覆盖问题。这些表征也适用于鲁棒选择。
AI.result: 该问题可以精确地表征为整数线性规划或在特定条件下的集合多覆盖/集合覆盖问题。这一联系使得设计者能够利用集合多覆盖问题丰富的文献中的算法来选择最小的执行器子集，包括不需要暴力搜索的精确解。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立的最小执行器选择问题与集合多覆盖问题之间的联系，使得设计者可以利用现有算法高效地选择执行器，包括鲁棒设计。
AI.translation: 选择少量可用执行器以确保线性系统的可控性是控制理论中的一个基本问题。以往的工作要么侧重于最优性能，要么简化可控性问题，要么在结构假设下使系统可控，例如在图中或当输入矩阵是设计参数时。我们推广了这些方法，对一般的最小执行器选择问题提供了精确的表征，即给定一组执行器，由固定的输入矩阵描述，目标是选择最少的执行器使系统可控。我们表明，该问题可以等效地表述为整数线性规划，并且，如果驱动通道足够独立，则可以表述为具有多重性约束的集合多覆盖问题。如果状态矩阵具有所有不同的特征值，则后者的等价性始终成立，在这种情况下，它简化为集合覆盖问题。即使需要容忍给定数量故障执行器的鲁棒选择时，这种表征也成立。我们建立的联系使得设计者可以利用集合多覆盖问题丰富的文献中的算法来选择最小的执行器子集，包括不需要暴力搜索的精确解。
AI.summary: 本论文研究线性时不变系统中最小执行器选择问题，旨在从给定执行器中选择最少数目以确保系统可控性。作者将该问题推广并精确表征为整数线性规划或在特定条件下（如驱动通道独立性强或状态矩阵特征值不同）的集合多覆盖/集合覆盖问题。这一发现使得可以利用现有集合多覆盖算法高效选择执行器，包括鲁棒设计。
AI.keywords: 最小执行器选择, 可控性, 整数线性规划, 集合多覆盖, 线性时不变系统
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将一般的最小执行器选择问题精确地表征为整数线性规划或集合多覆盖/集合覆盖问题，从而将其与现有丰富的算法体系联系起来。这避免了暴力搜索，并为一个基本的控制问题提供了高效的解决方案，包括鲁棒选择。

title: Specular differentiation in one dimension: a quasi-mean value theorem, regularity, and discontinuities
comments: This version revises arXiv:2601.09900v4 by removing the material on numerical ODEs and adding new results on discontinuities and regularity. Accordingly, citations to this work in arXiv:2605.25490v1 and arXiv:2601.10950v3 refer to arXiv:2601.09900v4, not to the present version
summary: We develop a theory of specular differentiation on real intervals. The specular derivative is defined by averaging the angles associated with the forward and backward difference quotients and extends classical differentiation. For specularly differentiable and continuous functions, we establish a quasi-mean value theorem and use it to show that continuity of the specular derivative implies $C^1$-regularity. Without assuming continuity, we prove that the discontinuities at which the specular derivative is nonzero form an at most countable set; a nowhere-continuous example with identically zero specular derivative shows that this restriction is sharp. In the second-order theory of specular differentiation, we impose additional conditions on twice specularly differentiable functions to obtain a class that lies strictly between the classes $C^1$ and $C^2$.
comment: This version revises arXiv:2601.09900v4 by removing the material on numerical ODEs and adding new results on discontinuities and regularity. Accordingly, citations to this work in arXiv:2605.25490v1 and arXiv:2601.10950v3 refer to arXiv:2601.09900v4, not to the present version

AI.title_translation: 一维镜面微分：准中值定理、正则性和不连续性
AI.tldr: 本文发展了一维镜面微分理论，定义了其性质，建立了准中值定理，分析了其正则性和不连续性，并引入了介于$C^1$和$C^2$之间的二阶类别。
AI.motivation: 发展一种扩展经典微分的新镜面微分理论，并探索其性质，包括正则性和不连续性。
AI.method: 通过平均前向和后向差商的角度定义镜面导数；为镜面可微且连续的函数建立准中值定理；利用该定理证明镜面导数的连续性意味着$C^1$-正则性；证明镜面导数非零的不连续点构成至多可数集；提供一个处处不连续但镜面导数恒为零的例子；对二阶镜面可微函数施加额外条件以获得介于$C^1$和$C^2$之间的函数类。
AI.result: 为镜面可微且连续的函数建立了准中值定理；镜面导数的连续性意味着$C^1$-正则性；镜面导数非零的不连续点构成至多可数集；一个处处不连续但镜面导数恒为零的例子表明了该限制的精确性；在二阶镜面微分理论中，确定了一个严格介于$C^1$和$C^2$之间的函数类。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功地发展了镜面微分的综合理论，定义了其性质，建立了准中值定理，刻画了其正则性和不连续性，并将其扩展到二阶理论，弥补了$C^1$和$C^2$类之间的空白。
AI.translation: 我们将在一维实区间上发展镜面微分理论。镜面导数通过平均与前向和后向差商相关的角度来定义，并扩展了经典微分。对于镜面可微且连续的函数，我们建立了一个准中值定理，并用它来表明镜面导数的连续性意味着$C^1$-正则性。在不假设连续性的情况下，我们证明了镜面导数非零的不连续点构成至多可数集；一个处处不连续但镜面导数恒为零的例子表明了该限制的精确性。在二阶镜面微分理论中，我们对二次镜面可微函数施加额外条件，以获得一个严格介于$C^1$和$C^2$类之间的函数类。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种在实区间上进行镜面微分的新理论，通过平均差商的角度来定义，扩展了经典微分。它为连续且镜面可微的函数建立了准中值定理，证明了连续的镜面导数意味着$C^1$-正则性。研究还表明，镜面导数非零的不连续点至多是可数的，并提供了一个精确的例子。此外，它定义了一个严格介于$C^1$和$C^2$之间的二阶镜面微分类。
AI.keywords: 镜面微分, 准中值定理, 正则性, 不连续性, C1-正则性
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过基于差商平均角度来定义“镜面微分”，引入了经典微分的一个有趣扩展。准中值定理的建立以及对正则性和不连续性的分析提供了坚实的理论基础。利用二阶镜面微分识别出一个严格介于$C^1$和$C^2$之间的函数类尤其具有创新性，预示着数学分析和函数理论中潜在的新方向。明确提及一个精确的处处不连续例子也突出了这项工作的严谨性。

title: Panning for Gold: Expanding Domain-Specific Knowledge Graphs with General Knowledge
summary:
Domain-specific knowledge graphs (DKGs) are critical yet often suffer from limited coverage compared to General Knowledge Graphs (GKGs). Existing tasks to enrich DKGs rely primarily on extracting knowledge from external unstructured data or completing KGs through internal reasoning, but the scope and quality of such integration remain limited. This highlights a critical gap: little systematic exploration has been conducted on how comprehensive, high-quality GKGs can be effectively leveraged to supplement DKGs.
  To address this gap, we propose a new and practical task: domain-specific knowledge graph fusion (DKGF), which aims to mine and integrate relevant facts from general knowledge graphs into domain-specific knowledge graphs to enhance their completeness and utility. Unlike previous research, this new task faces two key challenges: (1) high ambiguity of domain relevance, i.e., difficulty in determining whether knowledge from a GKG is truly relevant to the target domain , and (2) cross-domain knowledge granularity misalignment, i.e., GKG facts are typically abstract and coarse-grained, whereas DKGs frequently require more contextualized, fine-grained representations aligned with particular domain scenarios.
  To address these, we present ExeFuse, a neuro-symbolic framework based on a novel Fact-as-Program paradigm. ExeFuse treats fusion as an executable process, utilizing neuro-symbolic execution to infer logical relevance beyond surface similarity and employing target space grounding to calibrate granularity. We construct new datasets to establish the first standardized evaluation suite for this task. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ExeFuse effectively overcomes domain barriers to achieve superior fusion performance.

AI.title_translation: “淘金”: 使用通用知识扩展领域特定知识图谱
AI.tldr: 提出一种新的任务DKGF和神经符号框架ExeFuse，通过整合通用知识图谱来增强领域特定知识图谱的完整性和实用性，有效解决了领域相关性模糊和知识粒度错位问题。
AI.motivation: 领域特定知识图谱（DKGs）覆盖范围有限。现有方法主要依赖从非结构化数据中提取知识或通过内部推理完成知识图谱，但集成范围和质量有限。缺乏系统探索如何有效利用通用知识图谱（GKGs）来补充DKGs。
AI.method: 提出新的任务“领域特定知识图谱融合（DKGF）”，旨在从通用知识图谱中挖掘并整合相关事实到领域特定知识图谱中。为解决高领域相关性模糊和跨领域知识粒度错位两大挑战，提出了神经符号框架ExeFuse，该框架基于“事实即程序”范式，利用神经符号执行推理逻辑相关性，并采用目标空间接地校准粒度。构建了新的数据集以建立标准化评估套件。
AI.result: ExeFuse有效克服了领域障碍，实现了卓越的融合性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了领域特定知识图谱融合（DKGF）这一新任务，并开发了神经符号框架ExeFuse，成功解决了DKGs与GKGs融合中的关键挑战，显著提升了DKGs的完整性和实用性。
AI.translation:
领域特定知识图谱（DKGs）至关重要，但与通用知识图谱（GKGs）相比，其覆盖范围通常有限。现有丰富DKG的任务主要依赖于从外部非结构化数据中提取知识或通过内部推理完成知识图谱，但这种集成的范围和质量仍然有限。这突显了一个关键的空白：关于如何有效利用全面、高质量的GKGs来补充DKGs，目前还没有进行系统的探索。
为了解决这一空白，我们提出了一项新的实用任务：领域特定知识图谱融合（DKGF），旨在从通用知识图谱中挖掘并整合相关事实到领域特定知识图谱中，以增强其完整性和实用性。与以往研究不同，这项新任务面临两大关键挑战：（1）领域相关性高度模糊，即难以确定GKG中的知识是否真正与目标领域相关；（2）跨领域知识粒度错位，即GKG事实通常是抽象和粗粒度的，而DKGs经常需要更具上下文、细粒度的表示，以与特定领域场景对齐。
为了解决这些问题，我们提出了ExeFuse，一个基于新颖的“事实即程序”范式的神经符号框架。ExeFuse将融合视为一个可执行过程，利用神经符号执行推断超越表面相似性的逻辑相关性，并采用目标空间接地来校准粒度。我们构建了新的数据集，为这项任务建立了第一个标准化的评估套件。广泛的实验表明，ExeFuse有效克服了领域障碍，实现了卓越的融合性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对领域特定知识图谱（DKGs）覆盖范围有限的问题，提出了一项名为“领域特定知识图谱融合（DKGF）”的新任务，旨在从通用知识图谱（GKGs）中挖掘并整合相关知识以增强DKGs的完整性。为应对领域相关性模糊和知识粒度错位两大挑战，研究者开发了神经符号框架ExeFuse，该框架采用“事实即程序”范式，通过神经符号执行和目标空间接地来解决融合过程中的复杂性。通过构建新数据集进行标准化评估，实验证明ExeFuse能够有效提升DKGF任务的性能。
AI.keywords: 领域特定知识图谱, 通用知识图谱, 知识图谱融合, 神经符号框架, 知识粒度对齐
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种新颖且实用的方法来解决领域特定知识图谱与通用知识图谱融合的关键挑战。其创新之处在于定义了DKGF任务，并引入了“事实即程序”范式下的神经符号框架ExeFuse，有效处理了领域相关性模糊和知识粒度错位问题。通过将融合视为可执行过程，ExeFuse超越了传统的基于表面相似性的方法，为知识图谱的扩展和应用提供了有价值的思路。构建标准化数据集也为未来的研究奠定了基础。

title: StaleFlow: Staleness-Aware Data Management for Mitigating Data Skewness in Fully Disaggregated RL Post-Training
summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has become pivotal for enhancing the capabilities of modern large models. A recent trend is to develop RL systems with a fully disaggregated architecture, which decouples the three RL phases (rollout, reward, and training) onto separate resources and executes them asynchronously. However, two critical data-level concerns arise: (1) asynchronous execution leads to data staleness in trajectories (the data generated by rollout) as the model parameters used in rollout may not be up to date, which impairs RL convergence; and (2) the length variation of trajectories introduces severe data skewness, leading to workload imbalance and degraded system performance.
  Existing systems fail to address these two concerns in a unified manner. Techniques that tightly control data staleness often constrain effective data skewness mitigation, while aggressive data skewness mitigation tends to exacerbate data staleness. As a result, systems are forced to trade off convergence for performance, or vice versa. To address this, we propose StaleFlow, an RL post-training system that jointly tackles data staleness and skewness. First, to control staleness, StaleFlow introduces a global consistency protocol that tracks the full lifecycle of each trajectory and constrains staleness. Second, to mitigate skewness, StaleFlow re-designs the RL system architecture by constructing data servers for trajectories and parameters to achieve flexible rollout coordination. Subsequently, we develop a suite of staleness-aware, throughput-oriented strategies to enhance system performance. Evaluations show that StaleFlow achieves up to 1.42-2.68$\times$ (1.18-1.91$\times$ on average) higher throughput than state-of-the-art systems, without compromising convergence. Our source code is available: https://github.com/psrl-project/psrl.

AI.title_translation: StaleFlow：面向完全解耦RL后训练中缓解数据倾斜的陈旧性感知数据管理
AI.tldr: StaleFlow是一个RL后训练系统，通过引入全局一致性协议和重新设计系统架构，联合解决了完全解耦RL系统中数据陈旧性和数据倾斜的问题，显著提高了吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 在完全解耦的RL后训练系统中，异步执行导致数据陈旧性，损害RL收敛；同时，轨迹长度变化引入严重的数据倾斜，导致工作负载不平衡和系统性能下降。现有系统无法统一解决这两个问题，被迫在收敛性和性能之间进行权衡。
AI.method: 我们提出了StaleFlow系统，它联合解决数据陈旧性和倾斜问题。首先，通过引入一个全局一致性协议来跟踪每个轨迹的完整生命周期并限制陈旧性。其次，通过构建用于轨迹和参数的数据服务器来重新设计RL系统架构，实现灵活的回滚协调，并开发了一套陈旧性感知、吞吐量导向的策略来提高系统性能。
AI.result: StaleFlow的吞吐量比现有最先进系统高出1.42-2.68倍（平均高出1.18-1.91倍），且不损害收敛性。
AI.conclusion: StaleFlow成功地在完全解耦的RL后训练中联合解决了数据陈旧性和数据倾斜问题，显著提高了系统吞吐量而不牺牲收敛性。
AI.translation:
强化学习（RL）后训练已成为增强现代大型模型能力的关键。最近的趋势是开发具有完全解耦架构的RL系统，该架构将RL的三个阶段（回滚、奖励和训练）解耦到独立的资源上并异步执行。然而，出现了两个关键的数据层面问题：（1）异步执行导致轨迹（由回滚生成的数据）中的数据陈旧性，因为回滚中使用的模型参数可能不是最新的，这会损害RL收敛；（2）轨迹长度的变化引入严重的数据倾斜，导致工作负载不平衡和系统性能下降。
现有系统未能以统一的方式解决这两个问题。严格控制数据陈旧性的技术通常会限制有效的数据倾斜缓解，而积极的数据倾斜缓解往往会加剧数据陈旧性。因此，系统被迫在收敛性与性能之间进行权衡，反之亦然。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了StaleFlow，一个RL后训练系统，它联合解决了数据陈旧性和倾斜问题。首先，为了控制陈旧性，StaleFlow引入了一个全局一致性协议，跟踪每个轨迹的完整生命周期并限制陈旧性。其次，为了缓解倾斜，StaleFlow通过构建用于轨迹和参数的数据服务器来重新设计RL系统架构，以实现灵活的回滚协调。随后，我们开发了一套陈旧性感知、吞吐量导向的策略来增强系统性能。评估表明，StaleFlow的吞吐量比现有最先进系统高出1.42-2.68倍（平均高出1.18-1.91倍），且不损害收敛性。我们的源代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/psrl-project/psrl。
AI.summary: 本文提出了StaleFlow，一个针对完全解耦RL后训练系统的创新数据管理方案，旨在联合解决数据陈旧性和数据倾斜两大挑战。StaleFlow通过引入全局一致性协议来管理数据陈旧性，并通过重新设计系统架构（构建数据服务器）并采用陈旧性感知、吞吐量导向的策略来缓解数据倾斜。实验证明，StaleFlow在不损害RL收敛性的前提下，显著提高了系统的吞吐量。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 数据陈旧性, 数据倾斜, 完全解耦架构, StaleFlow
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个统一的框架StaleFlow，能够同时解决完全解耦RL后训练中长期存在的两大难题：数据陈旧性和数据倾斜。通过结合全局一致性协议和系统架构重设计，StaleFlow避免了传统系统在收敛性和性能之间的权衡，为大规模RL系统的设计提供了有价值的参考。

title: Turn-Based Structural Triggers: Structure-Conditioned Backdoors in Multi-Turn LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as multi-turn assistants and customized through instruction tuning with project-specific training components. This practice creates a supply-chain risk when organizations reuse third-party fine-tuning frameworks, trainer extensions, or outsourced training code: an adversary who subtly compromises the loss-computation component can inject malicious supervision during fine-tuning while leaving the stored training corpus, model architecture, and deployment interface unchanged. Existing LLM backdoors and defenses are largely prompt-centric, relying on lexical, syntactic, or semantic patterns in user inputs while overlooking structural signals in multi-turn conversations. We propose Turn-based Structural Trigger (TST), a prompt-free backdoor that uses dialogue turn position as its activation condition. TST exploits structural cues implicitly encoded by chat templates and is implanted without modifying the stored dialogue corpus. Its trigger is automatically present once the conversation reaches the attacker-specified turn, making activation independent of downstream user inputs and resistant to prompt filtering, sanitization, and paraphrasing. In our primary setting, the model behaves normally during early interactions and activates the attacker-defined behavior only after the conversation reaches the designated structural condition. Across four open-source LLM families, TST achieves an average Attack Success Rate of 98.10% on target turns and a Clean Rate of 99.96% on non-target turns, while retaining 97.78% of clean-model utility. These results identify dialogue structure as an overlooked attack surface and motivate structure-aware auditing beyond prompt inspection.

AI.title_translation: 基于回合的结构化触发器：多轮语言模型中的条件结构后门
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为TST（回合制结构触发器）的新型后门攻击方法，它利用对话轮次作为触发条件，而非依赖用户输入。TST能够成功绕过现有的防御机制，并在多种开源语言模型上实现了高攻击成功率和高干净率，同时保持了模型原有的效用。研究强调了对话结构作为潜在攻击面的重要性，并呼吁进行超越提示检查的结构感知审计。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作多轮助手，并通过特定项目进行指令调优，存在供应链风险，特别是当组织重用第三方微调框架、训练器扩展或外包训练代码时。攻击者可以悄悄地破坏损失计算组件，在不修改存储的训练语料库、模型架构或部署接口的情况下，在微调过程中注入恶意监督。现有的LLM后门和防御措施主要集中在提示上，忽略了多轮对话中的结构信号。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“回合制结构触发器”（TST）的无提示后门攻击方法。TST利用对话的轮次位置作为激活条件，通过利用聊天模板中隐含的结构线索来植入，而无需修改存储的对话语料库。其触发器一旦对话达到攻击者指定的轮次就会自动出现，激活与下游用户输入无关，并能抵抗提示过滤、清理和释义。
AI.result: 在四个开源LLM家族上，TST在目标轮次上的平均攻击成功率为98.10%，在非目标轮次上的干净率为99.96%，同时保持了97.78%的干净模型效用。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，对话结构是一个被忽视的攻击面，并促使进行超越提示检查的结构感知审计。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署为多轮助手，并通过包含项目特定的训练组件的指令调优来进行定制。这种做法带来了供应链风险，因为组织会重用第三方微调框架、训练器扩展或外包的训练代码：一个巧妙破坏损失计算组件的攻击者，可以在不更改存储的训练语料库、模型架构和部署接口的情况下，在微调过程中注入恶意监督。现有的LLM后门和防御措施在很大程度上是面向提示的，依赖于用户输入的词汇、语法或语义模式，而忽略了多轮对话中的结构信号。我们提出了回合制结构触发器（TST），一种无提示后门，它使用对话轮次位置作为其激活条件。TST利用了聊天模板中隐含的结构线索，并且无需修改存储的对话语料库即可植入。一旦对话达到攻击者指定的轮次，其触发器就会自动出现，使得激活独立于下游用户输入，并能抵抗提示过滤、清理和释义。在我们的主要设置中，模型在早期交互期间表现正常，仅在对话达到指定的结构条件后才激活攻击者定义的行为。在四个开源LLM家族上，TST在目标轮次上的平均攻击成功率为98.10%，在非目标轮次上的干净率为99.96%，同时保持了97.78%的干净模型效用。这些结果将对话结构确定为一个被忽视的攻击面，并促使进行超越提示检查的结构感知审计。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为“回合制结构触发器”（TST）的新型后门攻击方法，它利用对话轮次位置作为触发条件，而非依赖用户输入。TST能够绕过现有的提示中心防御机制，在多个开源LLM家族上实现了高攻击成功率（98.10%）和高干净率（99.96%），同时保持了模型效用（97.78%）。研究强调了对话结构作为攻击面的重要性，并呼吁进行结构感知的审计。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 后门攻击, 回合制结构触发器, 对话结构, 供应链安全
AI.comments: 这项研究提出了一个新颖且重要的后门攻击向量，它利用了LLM多轮交互的结构特性，这是一个之前被忽视的攻击面。TST的无提示和自动激活特性使其非常难以检测和防御。研究结果令人担忧，表明当前的LLM安全措施可能不足以应对此类结构化攻击。未来的工作可以探索更有效的结构感知防御机制，以及对LLM供应链安全进行更全面的审计。

title: Unsupervised Material Fingerprinting: Ultra-fast hyperelastic model discovery from full-field experimental measurements
summary: Material Fingerprinting is a lookup table-based strategy to discover material models from experimental measurements, which completely avoids the need to solve an optimization problem. In an offline phase, a comprehensive database of simulated material responses, so-called material fingerprints, is generated for a predefined experimental setup. This database can then be used repeatedly in the online phase to discover material models corresponding to experimentally measured observations. To this end, the experimentally measured fingerprint is compared with all fingerprints in the database to identify the closest match. The primary advantage of this strategy is that it does not require solving a continuous optimization problem. This avoids the associated computational costs as well as issues of ill-posedness caused by local minima in non-convex optimization landscapes. Material Fingerprinting has been successfully demonstrated for supervised datasets consisting of stress-strain pairs, as well as for unsupervised datasets involving full-field displacements and net reaction forces. However, to date, there is no experimental validation for the latter approach which is the objective of this work.

AI.title_translation: 无监督材料指纹识别：从全场实验测量中超高速发现超弹性模型
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需复杂优化的超弹性模型超高速发现方法——无监督材料指纹识别，并致力于完成其实验验证。
AI.motivation: 传统的材料模型发现通常需要求解计算成本高昂且易受局部极小值影响的连续优化问题，而材料指纹识别技术虽然在监督学习和理论上展现出优势，但目前缺乏针对全场位移和净反力等无监督数据集的实际实验验证。
AI.method: 提出一种无监督材料指纹识别方法，离线生成模拟材料响应的综合数据库（材料指纹），在线阶段将实验测量的指纹与数据库中的指纹进行比较以匹配最接近的模型，从而完全避免了求解非凸优化问题。
AI.result: 论文提出了针对无监督全场测量数据集的材料指纹识别方法，并以实现该方法的实验验证为研究目标。
AI.conclusion: 本文致力于通过实验验证无监督材料指纹识别方法，从而实现超弹性模型的超高速发现。
AI.translation: 材料指纹识别是一种基于查找表的策略，用于从实验测量中发现材料模型，从而完全避免了求解优化问题的需要。在离线阶段，针对预定义的实验装置生成模拟材料响应的综合数据库（称为材料指纹）。然后，该数据库可以在在线阶段反复使用，以发现与实验测量观测值相对应的材料模型。为此，将实验测量的指纹与数据库中的所有指纹进行比较，以确定最匹配的指纹。这种策略的主要优点是它不需要求解连续优化问题。这避免了相关计算成本以及非凸优化局势中由局部极小值引起的适定性问题。材料指纹识别已成功应用于由应力-应变对组成的有监督数据集，以及涉及全场位移和净反力的无监督数据集。然而，迄今为止，后一种方法尚无实验验证，这也是本工作的目标。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了无监督材料指纹识别技术，旨在通过将实验测量的全场位移和净反力与离线模拟数据库进行比对，以实现超弹性模型的超高速发现，并首次致力于该方法的实验验证。
AI.keywords: 材料指纹识别, 超弹性模型, 全场测量, 无监督学习, 实验验证
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入无监督材料指纹识别方法，在超弹性模型的实验测量和模型发现之间架起了桥梁，具有避免复杂优化和超高速发现的创新性。局限性在于摘要仅指出了目标是进行实验验证，具体的实验效果有待正文揭晓。

title: DeepSurvey-Bench: Evaluating Academic Value of Automatically Generated Scientific Surveys
summary: The rapid development of automated survey generation technology has made it increasingly important to establish a comprehensive benchmark to evaluate the quality of generated surveys. Most existing benchmarks first construct ground-truth datasets by selecting human-written surveys based on limited selection criteria, such as citation counts and structural coherence, and evaluate generated surveys primarily based on conventional quality dimensions, including structural quality and reference relevance. However, these benchmarks have two key issues: (1) the datasets are insufficiently reliable because the selection criteria only identify highly cited or structurally coherent surveys without verifying their academic value; (2) the evaluation metrics mainly reflect the surface-level quality of generated surveys and are insufficient to assess their academic value. Together, these issues prevent existing benchmarks from effectively assessing the academic value of generated surveys. To address the above problems, we propose DeepSurvey-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the academic value of automatically generated surveys. Specifically, our proposed benchmark introduces a set of academic value evaluation criteria covering three dimensions: informational value, scholarly communication value, and research guidance value. We first construct a reliable dataset with academic value annotations based on these criteria, and then evaluate the academic value of generated surveys according to these criteria through a multi-LLM-as-a-judge approach. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeepSurvey-Bench not only aligns closely with human assessments in evaluating the academic value of surveys, but also reveals underlying academic value beyond the reach of surface-level quality metrics, providing a foundation for fine-grained diagnosis and iterative improvement of generated surveys.

AI.title_translation: DeepSurvey-Bench：评估自动生成科学综述的学术价值
AI.tldr: DeepSurvey-Bench提出了一个全面的基准，用于评估自动生成综述的学术价值，解决了现有基准在数据集可靠性和评估指标方面的不足，并通过多LLM-as-a-judge方法和新的评估标准，实现了与人类评估高度一致且能揭示深层学术价值的评估。
AI.motivation: 现有自动综述生成技术评估基准存在两个主要问题：1) 数据集不可靠，因为其选择标准（如引用次数、结构连贯性）未能验证综述的学术价值；2) 评估指标主要反映表面质量，不足以评估学术价值。这些问题阻碍了现有基准有效评估生成综述的学术价值。
AI.method: 本研究提出了DeepSurvey-Bench，一个用于评估自动生成综述学术价值的综合基准。它引入了一套涵盖信息价值、学术交流价值和研究指导价值三个维度的学术价值评估标准。首先，基于这些标准构建了一个带有学术价值标注的可靠数据集。然后，通过多LLM-as-a-judge方法，根据这些标准评估生成综述的学术价值。
AI.result: 实验表明，DeepSurvey-Bench在评估综述学术价值方面与人类评估高度一致，并且能揭示超出表面质量指标范围的深层学术价值。
AI.conclusion: DeepSurvey-Bench为自动生成综述的学术价值评估提供了一个全面且可靠的基准，为生成综述的细粒度诊断和迭代改进奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 自动综述生成技术的快速发展使得建立一个全面的基准来评估生成综述的质量变得越来越重要。大多数现有基准首先通过基于有限选择标准（如引用次数和结构连贯性）选择人工撰写的综述来构建真实数据集，并主要根据结构质量和参考文献相关性等传统质量维度评估生成的综述。然而，这些基准存在两个关键问题：(1) 数据集不够可靠，因为选择标准只识别了高引用或结构连贯的综述，而没有验证其学术价值；(2) 评估指标主要反映生成综述的表面质量，不足以评估其学术价值。这些问题共同导致现有基准无法有效评估生成综述的学术价值。为了解决上述问题，我们提出了DeepSurvey-Bench，一个用于评估自动生成综述学术价值的综合基准。具体来说，我们提出的基准引入了一套涵盖信息价值、学术交流价值和研究指导价值三个维度的学术价值评估标准。我们首先基于这些标准构建了一个带有学术价值标注的可靠数据集，然后通过多LLM-as-a-judge方法根据这些标准评估生成综述的学术价值。大量实验表明，DeepSurvey-Bench不仅在评估综述学术价值方面与人类评估高度一致，而且揭示了超出表面质量指标范围的深层学术价值，为生成综述的细粒度诊断和迭代改进奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了DeepSurvey-Bench，一个用于评估自动生成科学综述学术价值的综合基准。针对现有基准在数据集可靠性（仅关注引用和结构，未验证学术价值）和评估指标（仅反映表面质量）方面的不足，DeepSurvey-Bench引入了信息价值、学术交流价值和研究指导价值三个维度的学术价值评估标准。该基准构建了带有学术价值标注的可靠数据集，并通过多LLM-as-a-judge方法进行评估。实验证明，DeepSurvey-Bench与人类评估高度一致，并能揭示深层学术价值，为综述的诊断和改进提供了基础。
AI.keywords: 自动综述生成, 学术价值评估, DeepSurvey-Bench, 基准测试, LLM-as-a-judge
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个更全面、更深入的基准来评估自动生成综述的“学术价值”，而非仅仅是表面质量。通过引入多维度评估标准和LLM-as-a-judge的方法，解决了现有基准在数据集可靠性和评估深度上的不足。这对于推动AI生成科学内容的发展具有重要意义，因为它提供了一个更接近人类专家评估的框架。

title: Emerging Threats and Countermeasures in Neuromorphic Systems: A Survey
comments: Survey paper on security and privacy in neuromorphic and in-memory computing systems (35 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables)
summary: Neuromorphic computing mimics brain-inspired mechanisms through spiking neurons and energy-efficient processing, offering a pathway to efficient in-memory computing (IMC). However, these advancements raise critical security and privacy concerns. As the adoption of bio-inspired architectures and memristive devices increases, so does the urgency to assess the vulnerability of these emerging technologies to hardware and software attacks. Emerging architectures introduce new attack surfaces, particularly due to asynchronous, event-driven processing and stochastic device behavior. The integration of memristors into neuromorphic hardware and software implementations in spiking neural networks offers diverse possibilities for advanced computing architectures, including their role in security-aware applications. This survey systematically analyzes the security landscape of neuromorphic systems, covering attack methodologies, side-channel vulnerabilities, and countermeasures. We focus on both hardware and software concerns relevant to spiking neural networks (SNNs) and hardware primitives, such as Physical Unclonable Functions (PUFs) and True Random Number Generators (TRNGs) for cryptographic and secure computation applications. We approach this analysis from diverse perspectives, from attack methodologies to countermeasure strategies that integrate efficiency and protection in brain-inspired hardware. This review not only maps the current landscape of security threats but provides a foundation for developing secure and trustworthy neuromorphic architectures.
comment: Survey paper on security and privacy in neuromorphic and in-memory computing systems (35 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables)

AI.title_translation: 神经拟态系统中的新兴威胁与对策：一项综述
AI.tldr: 本综述系统分析了神经拟态系统的安全格局，包括攻击方法、侧信道漏洞和对策，旨在为开发安全可信的神经拟态架构奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 神经拟态计算虽然能效高，但其生物启发架构、忆阻器集成以及异步、事件驱动处理和随机设备行为引入了新的攻击面，带来了严重的安全和隐私问题。因此，迫切需要评估这些新兴技术的漏洞。
AI.method: 本文通过系统分析神经拟态系统的安全格局，涵盖攻击方法、侧信道漏洞和对策。重点关注脉冲神经网络（SNNs）以及物理不可克隆函数（PUFs）和真随机数生成器（TRNGs）等硬件原语的软硬件问题。分析从攻击方法到对策策略，整合了类脑硬件的效率和保护。
AI.result: 综述绘制了当前安全威胁的图景，并为开发安全可信的神经拟态架构提供了基础。具体分析了攻击方法、侧信道漏洞和对策。
AI.conclusion: 本综述不仅描绘了当前安全威胁的图景，而且为开发安全可信的神经拟态架构奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 神经拟态计算通过脉冲神经元和节能处理模仿大脑启发机制，为高效内存计算（IMC）提供了一条途径。然而，这些进步也引发了严重的安全和隐私问题。随着仿生架构和忆阻器设备的采用增加，评估这些新兴技术对硬件和软件攻击的脆弱性变得越来越紧迫。新兴架构引入了新的攻击面，特别是由于异步、事件驱动处理和随机设备行为。忆阻器集成到神经拟态硬件和脉冲神经网络中的软件实现为先进计算架构提供了多种可能性，包括它们在安全感知应用中的作用。本综述系统分析了神经拟态系统的安全格局，涵盖攻击方法、侧信道漏洞和对策。我们重点关注与脉冲神经网络（SNNs）和硬件原语（如用于加密和安全计算应用的物理不可克隆函数（PUFs）和真随机数生成器（TRNGs））相关的硬件和软件问题。我们从攻击方法到对策策略等不同角度进行分析，整合了类脑硬件的效率和保护。本综述不仅描绘了当前安全威胁的图景，而且为开发安全可信的神经拟态架构奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本文对神经拟态系统中的新兴威胁和对策进行了全面综述。神经拟态计算虽然具有高效能优势，但其独特的架构和组件（如忆阻器）引入了新的安全漏洞。该综述系统地分析了攻击方法、侧信道漏洞和相应的对策，涵盖了脉冲神经网络和硬件原语的软硬件安全问题。研究旨在为未来开发安全可靠的神经拟态架构提供基础。
AI.keywords: 神经拟态系统, 安全威胁, 对策, 脉冲神经网络, 忆阻器
AI.comments: 这篇综述及时且重要，因为它全面地探讨了神经拟态计算这一新兴且前景广阔领域中的关键安全挑战。其创新性在于系统地梳理了软硬件层面可能面临的威胁及潜在对策，为该领域未来的安全设计和研究提供了宝贵的路线图。对攻击面和对策的深入分析，特别是对异步、事件驱动处理和随机设备行为的关注，凸显了神经拟态系统特有的安全复杂性。

title: Large Language Models as Automatic Annotators and Annotation Adjudicators for Fine-Grained Opinion Analysis
summary: Fine-grained opinion analysis of text provides a detailed understanding of expressed sentiments and their targets. Although this level of detail is valuable, annotating opinions in datasets for model training requires considerable human effort and substantial cost, especially across diverse domains and real-world applications. To address this shortage of domain-specific labelled datasets, we explore the feasibility of LLMs as automatic annotators for fine-grained opinion analysis. We use a declarative annotation pipeline, an approach that reduces the variability of manual prompt engineering when using LLMs to identify fine-grained opinion spans in text. We also present a dedicated methodology for an LLM to adjudicate multiple labels and produce final annotations, benchmarked against exact, flexible, and element-wise variants of a rule-based voting aggregator. We trial the pipeline with models of different sizes for the Aspect Sentiment Triplet Extraction (ASTE) and Aspect-Category-Opinion-Sentiment (ACOS) analysis tasks. Our results reveal a critical performance bifurcation: LLMs are reliable at the span level yet struggle to reproduce the relational structures that connect those spans faithfully. This suggests that LLMs are better positioned as high-fidelity annotation assistants and data augmentation tools to expand fine-grained opinion-annotated datasets, rather than replacing human annotators entirely.

AI.title_translation: 大语言模型作为细粒度意见分析的自动标注器与标注仲裁员
AI.tldr: 大语言模型可作为细粒度意见分析的优秀标注助手和数据增强工具，擅长跨度识别但难以处理复杂的结构关系。
AI.motivation: 细粒度意见分析的文本标注需要大量的人工努力和高昂的成本，尤其是在跨领域和真实世界应用中，因此缺乏领域特定的标注数据集，作者旨在探索大语言模型作为自动标注器的可行性。
AI.method: 采用声明式标注流程来减少手动提示工程的可变性，并提出了一种专用的LLM仲裁方法来裁决多个标签并生成最终标注，同时在ASTE和ACOS任务上对不同规模的模型进行了试验。
AI.result: 研究揭示了一个关键的性能分水岭：LLM在跨度（span）级别表现可靠，但难以准确重现连接这些跨度的关系结构。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型非常适合作为高保真的标注助手和数据扩充工具，用于扩展细粒度意见标注数据集，而不宜完全取代人工。
AI.translation: 文本的细粒度意见分析可以详细理解表达的情感及其目标。尽管这种详细程度很有价值，但为模型训练数据集标注意见需要大量的人工努力和高昂的成本，尤其是在不同的领域和真实世界的应用中。为了解决领域特定标注数据集短缺的问题，我们探索了大型语言模型（LLM）作为细粒度意见分析自动标注器的可行性。我们使用了一种声明式标注流程，这种方法减少了在使用LLM识别文本中细粒度意见跨度时手动提示词工程的可变性。我们还提出了一种专用的方法，让LLM裁决多个标签并生成最终标注，并针对基于规则的投票聚合器的精确、灵活和逐元素变体进行了基准测试。我们在方面情感三元组提取（ASTE）和方面-类别-意见-情感（ACOS）分析任务上，对不同规模的模型进行了管道试验。我们的结果揭示了一个关键的性能分水岭：LLM在跨度级别是可靠的，但在忠实重现连接这些跨度的关系结构方面表现不佳。这表明，LLM更适合作为高保真标注助手和数据增强工具来扩展细粒度意见标注数据集，而不是完全取代人类标注员。
AI.summary: 本文研究了利用大语言模型作为自动标注器和仲裁员来进行细粒度意见分析的可行性。通过提出声明式标注流程和专用仲裁方法，并在ASTE和ACOS任务上进行测试，结果表明LLM能够可靠地进行跨度级别的标注，但难以处理复杂的结构关系，因此更适合作为标注助手和数据增强工具。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 细粒度意见分析, 自动标注, 数据增强, 方面情感三元组提取
AI.comments: 该论文深入探讨了大语言模型在细粒度意见分析中的双重角色（自动标注器与仲裁员），揭示了其在跨领域标注任务中的潜力和局限性（尤其是在处理复杂关系结构时的挑战），为未来利用大语言模型辅助数据构建提供了重要的实证依据。

title: Hylog: A Hybrid Approach to Logging Text Production in Non-alphabetic Scripts
summary: Research keyloggers are essential for cognitive studies of text production, yet most fail to capture the on-screen transformations performed by Input Method Editors (IMEs) for non-alphabetic scripts. To address this methodological gap, we present Hylog, a novel hybrid logging system that combines analytical keylogging with ecological text logging for a more complete and finer-grained analysis. Our modular, open-source system uses plug-ins for standard applications (Microsoft Word, Google Chrome) to capture both keyboard output and rendered text, which a hybridizer module then synchronizes into a dual trace. To validate the system's technical feasibility and demonstrate its analytical capabilities, we conducted a proof-of-concept study where two volunteers translated a text into simplified Chinese. Hylog successfully captured keypresses and temporal intervals between Latin letters, Chinese characters, and IME confirmations -- some measurements invisible to traditional keyloggers. The resulting data enable the formulation of new, testable hypotheses about the cognitive restrictions and affordances at different linguistic layers in IME-mediated typing. Our plug-in architecture enables extension to other IME systems and fosters more inclusive multilingual text-production research.

AI.title_translation: Hylog：一种混合方法用于非字母文字的文本生产记录
AI.tldr: Hylog是一个混合日志系统，结合了分析性键盘记录和生态文本记录，用于记录非字母文字的文本输入过程，解决了传统键盘记录器无法捕捉输入法编辑器（IME）转换的问题。它能记录按键和渲染文本，并同步成双重轨迹，可用于分析IME输入过程中的认知机制。
AI.motivation: 传统的研究键盘记录器无法捕捉非字母文字输入过程中的输入法编辑器（IME）转换，存在方法学上的缺陷。
AI.method: Hylog系统结合了分析性键盘记录和生态文本记录，通过插件捕获键盘输出和渲染文本，并使用混合器模块同步成双重轨迹。
AI.result: Hylog成功捕获了按键和拉丁字母、汉字、IME确认之间的时间间隔，包括传统键盘记录器无法捕捉的测量数据，为IME输入过程中的认知机制研究提供了新的假设。
AI.conclusion: Hylog系统在技术上可行，并能进行精细的分析，其插件架构易于扩展，能够促进更具包容性的多语言文本生产研究。
AI.translation: 研究键盘记录器对于文本生产的认知研究至关重要，但大多数键盘记录器都无法捕捉非字母文字的输入法编辑器（IME）所执行的屏幕转换。为了解决这个方法学上的空白，我们提出了Hylog，一个新颖的混合日志系统，它结合了分析性键盘记录和生态文本记录，以实现更完整、更精细的分析。我们的模块化、开源系统使用标准应用程序（Microsoft Word、Google Chrome）的插件来捕获键盘输出和渲染文本，然后由一个混合器模块将它们同步成双重轨迹。为了验证该系统的技术可行性并展示其分析能力，我们进行了一项概念验证研究，其中两名志愿者将一段文本翻译成简体中文。Hylog成功捕获了按键以及拉丁字母、汉字和IME确认之间的时间间隔——其中一些测量对于传统的键盘记录器来说是看不见的。所得数据能够就IME介导的打字过程中不同语言层面的认知限制和允许因素提出新的、可检验的假设。我们的插件架构能够扩展到其他IME系统，并促进更具包容性的多语言文本生产研究。
AI.summary: Hylog是一个创新的混合日志系统，旨在解决传统键盘记录器在记录非字母文字（如中文）输入时无法捕捉输入法编辑器（IME）转换的问题。该系统结合了键盘记录和屏幕文本捕获，能够生成详细的输入过程数据，为研究IME输入背后的认知机制提供了新的途径。其模块化和开源设计便于扩展和应用。
AI.keywords: Hylog, 混合日志, 输入法编辑器, 文本生产, 认知研究
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的混合日志方法Hylog，解决了非字母文字文本输入研究中的一个关键技术难题。通过结合键盘记录和渲染文本捕获，Hylog能够提供比传统方法更精细、更全面的数据，为认知科学和人机交互领域的研究开辟了新的可能性。其开源和模块化设计也极大地促进了该技术的普及和进一步发展。然而，该研究仅进行了概念验证，未来需要更广泛的实验来验证其在不同语言、不同用户和不同应用场景下的有效性。

title: EEG-FM-Compass: Progress, Benchmarking, and Future Directions for EEG Foundation Models
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models (FMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for brain-computer interfaces, aiming to learn transferable neural representations from large-scale heterogeneous recordings. Despite rapid progress, a fair and comprehensive comparison of existing EEG FMs is still lacking, owing to inconsistent pre-training objectives, preprocessing choices, and downstream evaluation protocols. To fill this gap, we present EEG-FM-Compass. We first review 55 representative models and organize their design choices into a unified taxonomic framework including data standardization, model architectures, and self-supervised pre-training strategies. We then evaluate 12 open source FMs and competitive specialist baselines across 13 EEG datasets spanning nine brain-computer interface paradigms. Emphasizing real-world deployments, we consider both cross-subject generalization under a leave-one-subject-out protocol and rapid calibration under a within-subject few-shot setting. We further compare full-parameter fine-tuning with linear probing to assess the transferability of pre-trained representations, and examine the relationship between model scale and downstream performance. Our results indicate that: 1) linear probing is frequently insufficient; 2) specialist models trained from scratch remain competitive across many tasks; and 3) larger FMs do not necessarily yield better generalization performance under current data regimes and training practices.

AI.title_translation: 脑电图基础模型：进展、基准测试和未来方向
AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了EEG-FM-Compass，一个用于评估和比较脑电图基础模型（EEG FMs）的框架。通过对55个模型进行分类和对12个模型进行基准测试，研究发现线性探测通常不足以评估模型的迁移能力，从头开始训练的专用模型在许多任务上仍然具有竞争力，并且更大的基础模型并不一定能带来更好的泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏对现有脑电图基础模型（EEG FMs）进行公平和全面的比较，因为预训练目标、预处理选择和下游评估协议不一致。
AI.method: 1. 审查了55个代表性模型，并将它们的设计选择组织成一个统一的分类框架，包括数据标准化、模型架构和自监督预训练策略。 2. 评估了12个开源FM和有竞争力的专用基线模型，涵盖了9种脑机接口范式的13个EEG数据集。 3. 考虑了留一受试者交叉协议下的受试者间泛化和受试者内少样本设置下的快速校准。 4. 比较了全参数微调和线性探测，以评估预训练表示的可迁移性。 5. 检查了模型规模与下游性能之间的关系。
AI.result: 1. 线性探测通常不足以评估模型的迁移能力。 2. 从头开始训练的专用模型在许多任务上仍然具有竞争力。 3. 在当前的数据模式和训练实践下，更大的基础模型并不一定能带来更好的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 脑电图基础模型（EEG FMs）的研究进展迅速，但需要更一致的评估方法。该研究提出的EEG-FM-Compass框架为未来的EEG FM研究提供了基准和方向，并揭示了当前模型的一些局限性，例如线性探测的不足、专用模型的竞争力以及模型规模与泛化性能的关系并非简单正相关。
AI.translation: 脑电图（EEG）基础模型（FMs）最近已成为脑机接口的有前途的范例，旨在从大规模异构记录中学习可迁移的神经表征。尽管取得了快速进展，但由于预训练目标、预处理选择和下游评估协议不一致，仍然缺乏对现有EEG FM的公平和全面的比较。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了EEG-FM-Compass。我们首先回顾了55个代表性模型，并将它们的设计选择组织成一个统一的分类框架，包括数据标准化、模型架构和自监督预训练策略。然后，我们在涵盖九种脑机接口范式的13个EEG数据集上评估了12个开源FM和有竞争力的专用基线。我们强调实际部署，考虑了留一受试者交叉协议下的受试者间泛化和受试者内少样本设置下的快速校准。我们进一步比较了全参数微调和线性探测，以评估预训练表示的可迁移性，并检查了模型规模与下游性能之间的关系。我们的结果表明：1）线性探测通常不足；2）从头开始训练的专用模型在许多任务上仍然具有竞争力；3）在当前的数据模式和训练实践下，更大的FM不一定会带来更好的泛化性能。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了EEG-FM-Compass，一个用于评估和比较脑电图基础模型（EEG FMs）的框架。该框架通过对现有模型进行分类和在多个数据集上进行基准测试，旨在解决当前EEG FMs评估不一致的问题。研究结果表明，线性探测评估方法存在局限性，从头训练的专用模型仍然具有竞争力，并且模型规模并非泛化性能的唯一决定因素。
AI.keywords: 脑电图基础模型,EEG-FM-Compass,脑机接口,模型评估,泛化性能
AI.comments: 该研究对脑电图基础模型领域做出了重要贡献，通过提出EEG-FM-Compass框架，为该领域的研究和发展提供了重要的基准和方向。该研究的创新之处在于其全面的模型分类和跨数据集的基准测试，以及对不同评估方法的深入分析。然而，研究也指出了当前EEG FM的一些局限性，例如线性探测的不足和模型规模与泛化性能的关系并非简单正相关，这为未来的研究提供了重要的启示。

title: When LLM Essays Outscore Student Essays: What a Korean Writing Rubric Rewards and Where Readers Disagree
summary: LLMs now help students plan, draft, and revise essays. Educational assessment therefore faces a basic question: how should student and LLM writing be compared? Rubrics assign points to content, organization, and expression. Their total can still hide which criteria drive the comparison, where ratings approach the maximum, and where readers disagree. We therefore conducted a secondary, post hoc audit of a Korean writing study with source-informed scoring. Three Korean language and literature majors used a 16-criterion, 100-point rubric to score six student essays and 24 essays from four LLMs prompted for three school levels. After source disclosure, they helped develop the rubric and, according to the protocol, scored the Phase 2 essays without gold labels while recording source judgments. The pooled LLM mean exceeds the student mean by 18.35 points. Orthographic norms and genre-appropriate register contribute 8.19 points, or 44.7% of the gap. All 72 LLM ratings reach the orthographic maximum, and 70 reach the register maximum. The student source mean is highest or tied highest on both creativity criteria and natural Korean phrasing, where reader agreement is weak. Criterion-level auditing therefore offers a deeper account of human and LLM writing than the total alone.

AI.title_translation: 当大型语言模型论文超越学生论文：韩国写作评分标准奖励什么以及读者意见不一之处
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型（LLM）生成的论文在韩国写作研究中，在正字法规范和语域恰当的语域方面得分很高，从而在总分上超越了学生写的论文。然而，学生在创造力和自然韩语表达方面表现更好，但在这些方面，评分者之间存在分歧。对评分标准的细致分析比仅看总分更能揭示人类和 LLM 写作的差异。
AI.motivation: 评估 LLM 生成的论文与学生写的论文之间的质量差异，以及理解评分标准如何影响这种评估，因为总分可能无法揭示驱动比较的具体标准、评分接近满分的情况以及评分者之间的分歧。
AI.method: 对一项韩国写作研究进行了二次、事后审计，使用了有来源信息的评分。三名韩语和文学专业的学生使用了一个包含16个标准、100个点的评分标准，对6篇学生论文和24篇来自4个 LLM 的论文进行了评分。在披露来源后，他们帮助制定了评分标准，并根据协议在没有黄金标签的情况下对第二阶段的论文进行了评分，同时记录了来源判断。
AI.result: LLM 论文的平均得分比学生论文高18.35分。正字法规范和语域恰当的语域占了8.19分，即差距的44.7%。所有72篇 LLM 论文在正字法方面都达到了最高分，70篇在语域方面达到了最高分。学生在创造力标准和自然韩语表达方面得分最高或并列最高，但在这些方面，评分者之间的一致性较差。
AI.conclusion: 对评分标准的逐项审计比仅看总分更能深入地解释人类写作和 LLM 写作的差异，突显了 LLM 在某些方面（如正字法和语域）的优势，以及在另一些方面（如创造力和自然语言）的不足，同时指出了评分者在评估这些方面时存在分歧。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）现在可以帮助学生规划、起草和修改论文。因此，教育评估面临一个基本问题：应该如何比较学生和 LLM 的写作？评分标准对内容、组织和表达进行评分。但它们的总分可能隐藏了哪些标准驱动了比较，哪些评分接近满分，以及评分者在哪里存在分歧。因此，我们对一项韩国写作研究进行了二次、事后审计，使用了有来源信息的评分。三名韩语和文学专业的学生使用了一个包含16个标准、100个点的评分标准，对6篇学生论文和24篇来自4个 LLM 的论文进行了评分。在披露来源后，他们帮助制定了评分标准，并根据协议在没有黄金标签的情况下对第二阶段的论文进行了评分，同时记录了来源判断。LLM 的总平均得分比学生高18.35分。正字法规范和语域恰当的语域贡献了8.19分，占差距的44.7%。所有72篇 LLM 论文都在正字法方面达到了最高分，70篇在语域方面达到了最高分。学生在创造力标准和自然韩语表达方面得分最高或并列最高，而评分者在这两方面的一致性较差。因此，逐项审计比仅看总分更能深入地解释人类写作和 LLM 写作。
AI.summary: 这项研究发现，在韩国写作评分标准下，由大型语言模型（LLM）生成的论文平均得分比学生写的论文高18.35分。LLM 在正字法规范和语域恰当性方面表现出色，几乎在所有情况下都获得了最高分。然而，学生在创造力和自然韩语表达方面得分更高，尽管在这些领域，评分者之间的一致性较差。研究强调，对评分标准的细致分析比仅看总分更能揭示人类和 LLM 写作之间的细微差别。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 写作评估, 评分标准, 学生写作, LLM 论文
AI.comments: 这项研究揭示了大型语言模型在写作评估中的潜力，尤其是在遵循既定规范方面。然而，它也强调了在评估创造力和自然语言流畅性等更主观的方面时，人类判断的细微差别和潜在分歧。未来的研究可以探索如何调整评分标准，以更好地平衡 LLM 的规范遵循能力和人类写作的创造性与独特性。此外，研究结果也可能对不同语言和文化背景下的写作评估提出启示。

title: Bounded Normative Equivalence in Human-AI Cooperation: Group Behaviour, Not Partner Labels, Predicts Cooperation under Anonymous Aggregate Feedback
summary: The introduction of artificial intelligence (AI) agents into human groups raises questions about how they influence cooperative social norms. Prior work has examined human-AI and human-robot teaming in small groups, but less is known about whether an AI label alters cooperation and norm-related outcomes in repeated group interactions. We report an online experiment using a repeated four-player Public Goods Game. Each group comprised three human participants and one bot, framed either as human or AI, following one of three predefined strategies: unconditional cooperation, conditional cooperation, or free-riding. Among 236 participants, cooperation was primarily associated with the group's contribution in the previous round and with participants' own previous contributions. These patterns were similar across human- and AI-labelled conditions, and cooperation levels did not differ significantly by agent label; a formal equivalence test (TOST) indicated that any label effect was smaller than +/-5 tokens (5% of the endowment). We also found no evidence of label-based differences in norm persistence in a follow-up Prisoner's Dilemma or in participants' normative perceptions. We describe this pattern as bounded normative equivalence: under anonymous aggregate group feedback, an AI label produced no detectable differences in observed cooperation or norm-related outcomes. We argue that this equivalence is bounded by the informational structure of the setting: aggregate feedback makes individual actions difficult to attribute, diluting the identity cues that might otherwise trigger differentiation. These findings suggest that, in collective settings where individual contributions are not identifiable, cooperative norms can extend to groups that include artificial agents.

AI.title_translation: 人类-人工智能合作中的有界规范等价性：群体行为而非伙伴标签预测匿名聚合反馈下的合作
AI.tldr: 在匿名聚合反馈下，AI标签对人类合作行为和规范认知没有显著影响，因为群体反馈模糊了个体身份，使得AI和人类的合作模式相似。
AI.motivation: 探究AI在人类群体中引入时如何影响合作的社会规范，特别是AI标签是否会改变合作和与规范相关的结果。
AI.method: 进行了一项在线实验，使用重复的四人公共物品博弈，其中包含三名人类参与者和一名机器人，机器人被标记为人类或AI，并遵循三种预设策略之一：无条件合作、条件合作或搭便车。
AI.result: 合作主要与上一轮的群体贡献和参与者自身的先前贡献相关。在人类和AI标记的条件下，这些模式相似，合作水平在代理标签之间没有显著差异。正式等价性检验（TOST）表明，任何标签效应都小于+/-5个代币。在后续的囚徒困境博弈中，也没有发现基于标签的规范持久性差异或参与者的规范认知差异。
AI.conclusion: 在匿名聚合反馈的集体设定下，AI标签不会对观察到的合作或与规范相关的结果产生可检测的差异，即存在有界的规范等价性。这种等价性受到信息结构的影响，聚合反馈模糊了个体身份，从而削弱了可能触发区分的身份线索。因此，在个体贡献无法识别的集体环境中，合作规范可以扩展到包含人工智能代理的群体。
AI.translation: 人工智能（AI）代理的引入引发了关于它们如何影响人类群体中合作社会规范的问题。先前的工作考察了小型群体中的人机和人机协作，但关于AI标签是否会改变重复群体互动中的合作和与规范相关的结果，人们知之甚少。我们报告了一项在线实验，使用重复的四人公共物品博弈。每个群体由三名人类参与者和一名机器人组成，机器人被标记为人类或AI，遵循三种预定义的策略之一：无条件合作、条件合作或搭便车。在236名参与者中，合作主要与上一轮的群体贡献和参与者自身的先前贡献相关。这些模式在人类和AI标记的条件下相似，合作水平因代理标签而异没有显著差异；正式等价性检验（TOST）表明，任何标签效应都小于+/-5个代币（占捐赠的5%）。我们也未发现后续囚徒困境博弈中规范持久性或参与者规范感知的基于标签的差异证据。我们将这种模式描述为有界的规范等价性：在匿名聚合群体反馈下，AI标签在观察到的合作或与规范相关的结果方面没有产生可检测的差异。我们认为，这种等价性受到该情境信息结构的限制：聚合反馈使得个体行为难以归因，从而稀释了可能触发区分的身份线索。这些发现表明，在个体贡献无法识别的集体环境中，合作规范可以扩展到包含人工智能代理的群体。
AI.summary: 该研究通过一项在线公共物品博弈实验，探讨了AI标签对人类合作行为的影响。实验结果表明，无论参与者被告知他们正在与人类还是AI合作，合作水平和规范感知基本一致。这种“有界的规范等价性”现象归因于匿名聚合反馈机制，它模糊了参与者的个体身份，使得AI标签的作用减弱。研究得出结论，在个体贡献难以辨认的群体场景中，合作规范能够延伸至包含AI的群体。
AI.keywords: 有界规范等价性, 人类-人工智能合作, 公共物品博弈, 匿名聚合反馈, 规范持久性
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于提出了“有界的规范等价性”概念，并提供了实证证据。研究通过巧妙的实验设计，在匿名聚合反馈的背景下，分离了AI标签和个体身份识别的混淆因素，从而揭示了在特定条件下AI对人类合作规范影响的局限性。研究的价值在于为理解人机协作的社会动态提供了新的视角，并对未来AI在集体决策和合作场景中的应用具有指导意义。然而，研究的局限性在于实验环境的虚拟性以及参与者群体可能存在的特定偏好，未来研究可以考虑在更真实的场景下进行验证，并探索不同类型的AI代理和合作任务对规范等价性的影响。

title: Rethinking Federated Graph Foundation Models: A Graph-Language Alignment-based Approach
summary:
Recent studies of federated graph foundational models (FedGFMs) break the idealized and untenable assumption of having centralized data storage to train graph foundation models, and accommodate the reality of distributed, privacy-restricted data silos. Despite their simplicity and intuition, existing studies that project aligned generalizable knowledge onto a discrete token space via vector-quantized backbones suffer from irreversible knowledge loss during the quantization process. In this context, we argue that reconciling the semantic-structural orthogonality and integrity between pre-trained language models (PLMs) and graph neural networks (GNNs) is paramount for developing effective FedGFMs while simultaneously mitigating the severe data heterogeneity and communication constraints inherent in distributed, resource-limited environments.
  To address these issues, we propose FedGALA (Federated Graph And Language Alignment), a framework that resolves graph-based semantic-structural orthogonality and integrity in federated settings by employing unsupervised contrastive learning to align GNNs and frozen PLMs within a continuous embedding space, thereby capturing robust, transferable general knowledge. Subsequently, FedGALA leverages a communication-efficient prompt tuning mechanism to steer these pre-aligned encoders and frozen PLMs, facilitating effective adaptation to diverse downstream tasks while circumventing the prohibitive overhead of full-parameter fine-tuning. The comprehensive experiments validate that FedGALA outperforms all competitive baselines across multi-domain datasets on multiple tasks with up to 14.37% performance improvement.

title: CORE: Collaborative Reasoning via Cross Teaching
summary: Large language models exhibit complementary reasoning errors: on the same instance, one model may succeed with a particular decomposition while another fails. We propose Collaborative Reasoning (CORE), a training-time collaboration framework that converts peer success into a learning signal via a cross-teaching protocol. Each problem is solved in two stages: a cold round of independent sampling, followed by a contexted rescue round in which models that failed receive hint extracted from a successful peer. CORE optimizes a combined reward that balances (i) correctness, (ii) a lightweight DPP-inspired diversity term to reduce error overlap, and (iii) an explicit rescue bonus for successful recovery. We evaluate CORE across four standard reasoning datasets GSM8K, MATH, AIME, and GPQA. With only 1,000 training examples, a pair of small open source models (3B+4B) reaches Pass@2 of 99.54% on GSM8K and 92.08% on MATH, compared to 82.50% and 74.82% for single-model training. On harder datasets, the 3B+4B pair reaches Pass@2 of 77.34% on GPQA (trained on 348 examples) and 79.65% on AIME (trained on 792 examples), using a training-time budget of at most 1536 context tokens and 3072 generated tokens. Overall, these results show that training-time collaboration can reliably convert model complementarity into large gains without scaling model size.

title: Understanding Rate-Distortion Performance in Distributed Transformer Inference
summary: Transformers achieve superior performance on many tasks, but impose heavy compute and memory requirements during inference. This inference can be made more efficient by partitioning the process across multiple devices, which, in turn, requires compressing its intermediate representations. We study compressibility of transformer's intermediate representations via learned compression through the lens of rate-distortion and the theory of usable information. Our study reveals that, unlike convolutional models, deeper representations in transformers become more difficult to compress. The reason for this behavior is twofold: first, the complexity of representation increases as we move deeper into the transformer, necessitating a higher rate; and second, the higher complexity of representations worsens the generaliztion bound for learned entropy estimates, which further compromises compression performance. Through a combination of experiments and theory, we characterize and analyze the compressibility of transformer representations, derive bounds on the achievable rate of learned codecs applied to these representations, and offer a unified lens for understanding rate-distortion performance in representation coding.

title: Approximately Optimal Multi-Stream Quickest Change Detection
summary: This paper considers the constrained sampling multi-stream quickest change detection problem, also known as the bandit quickest change detection problem. One stream contains a change-point that shifts its mean by an unknown amount. The goal is to quickly detect this change while controlling for false alarms, while being only able to sample one stream at each time. We propose an algorithm that combines a decaying-$ε$-greedy stream switching rule with a Generalized Likelihood Ratio detection procedure for unknown post-change means. We provide performance bounds for our algorithm and show it achieves approximate asymptotic first-order optimality with respect to a commonly used surrogate. We are the first to provide guarantees in this setting without assumptions such as a discretized post-change parameter set or a lower bound on the magnitude of change. We provide guarantees for a wide range of light-tailed distributions, including sub-Gaussian and bounded support distributions.

title: Can Small Language Models Handle Context-Summarized Multi-Turn Customer-Service QA? A Synthetic Data-Driven Comparative Evaluation
comments: Published at Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing Section
summary: Customer-service question answering (QA) systems increasingly rely on conversational language understanding. While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance, their high computational cost and deployment constraints limit practical use in resource-constrained environments. Small Language Models (SLMs) provide a more efficient alternative, yet their effectiveness for multi-turn customer-service QA remains underexplored, particularly in scenarios requiring dialogue continuity and contextual understanding. This study investigates instruction-tuned SLMs for context-summarized multi-turn customer-service QA, using a history summarization strategy to preserve essential conversational state. We also introduce a conversation stage-based qualitative analysis to evaluate model behavior across different phases of customer-service interactions. Nine instruction-tuned low-parameterized SLMs are evaluated against three commercial LLMs using lexical and semantic similarity metrics alongside qualitative assessments, including human evaluation and LLM-as-a-judge methods. Results show notable variation across SLMs, with some models demonstrating near-LLM performance, while others struggle to maintain dialogue continuity and contextual alignment. These findings highlight both the potential and current limitations of low-parameterized language models for real-world customer-service QA systems.
comment: Published at Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing Section

title: MedTextWeaver: Procedural Knowledge Evolution in Agentic Medical Text Editing
summary: Medical text editing is essential for improving communication among diverse stakeholders in clinical settings. However, adapting LLM agents to this task remains challenging because expert supervision is often sparse, fragmented, and distributed across interacting quality dimensions. We identify that direct accumulation or retrieval of individual feedback is insufficient for effective adaptation, as fragmented evaluations do not directly translate into a coherent understanding of medical text quality. Based on this observation, we propose MedTextWeaver, a training-free framework that transforms fragmented evaluative evidence into global quality principles and actionable procedural knowledge for medical text editing. Across three clinical text datasets and a real-world validation experiment, MedTextWeaver consistently improves performance over strong LLM baselines and existing memory-based adaptation approaches. Further analysis demonstrates that the learned knowledge enables more effective adaptation under limited supervision while providing an explicit and interpretable interface between expert evaluations and LLM editing behavior.

title: Don't Judge a Book by its Cover: Testing LLMs' Robustness Under Logical Obfuscation
summary: Tasks such as solving arithmetic equations, evaluating truth tables, and completing syllogisms are handled well by large language models (LLMs) in their standard form, but they often fail when the same problems are posed in logically equivalent yet obfuscated formats. To study this vulnerability, we introduce Logifus, a structure-preserving logical obfuscation framework, and, utilizing this, we present LogiQAte, a first-of-its-kind diagnostic benchmark with 1,108 questions across four reasoning tasks: (i) Obfus FOL (first-order logic entailment under equivalence-preserving rewrites), (ii) Obfus Blood Relation (family-graph entailment under indirect relational chains), (iii) Obfus Number Series (pattern induction under symbolic substitutions), and (iv) Obfus Direction Sense (navigation reasoning under altered directions and reference frames). Across all the tasks, evaluating six state-of-the-art models, we find that obfuscation severely degrades zero-shot performance, with performance dropping on average by 47% for GPT-4o, 27% for GPT-5, and 22% for reasoning model, o4-mini. Our findings reveal that current LLMs parse questions without deep understanding, highlighting the urgency of building models that genuinely comprehend and preserve meaning beyond surface form.

title: Geometric Generalization of Neural Operators from a Kernel Integral Perspective
summary: Neural operators are neural network-based surrogate models for approximating partial differential equation solution operators, enabling efficient many-query computations in science and engineering when low-to-moderate accuracy is sufficient. Many applications, including engineering design, involve variable and often nonparametric geometries, for which generalization to unseen shapes remains a central practical challenge. In this work, we adopt a kernel-integral perspective motivated by classical boundary integral formulations and study operator learning on variable geometries through the approximation of geometry-dependent kernel operators, including singular kernels. This perspective clarifies a mechanism for geometric generalization for fixed linear operators and reveals a direct connection between operator learning and fast kernel summation methods. Leveraging this connection, we propose a multiscale point cloud neural operator inspired by Ewald summation, combining Fourier long-range interactions with local geometry-aware corrections. We further establish approximation guarantees for the resulting multiscale representation of linear operators defined by singular kernels. Numerical experiments demonstrate robust generalization across diverse geometries for several commonly used kernels, Laplace-type boundary integral maps, and a large-scale three-dimensional nonlinear vehicle flow example.

title: Phoenix: A Modular and Versatile Framework for C/C++ Pointer Analysis
comments: Accepted in the Tool Demonstration Track, Joint Conference of ISSTA and SPLASH (SPLASH/ISSTA 2026)
summary: We present Phoenix, a modular pointer analysis framework for C/C++ that unifies multiple alias analysis algorithms behind a single, stable interface. Phoenix addresses the fragmentation of today's C/C++ pointer analysis ecosystem by cleanly separating IR construction, constraint generation, solver backends, and client-facing queries-making analyses easy to compare, swap, and compose while exposing explicit precision-performance trade-offs. We evaluate two comparisons on 28 GNU coreutils programs: Phoenix-FICI versus SVF-FICI, where both analyses are flow-insensitive and context-insensitive, and Phoenix-FSCS versus SVF-FSCI, where the former is flow- and context-sensitive and the latter is flow-sensitive but context-insensitive. Phoenix-FICI is faster on all benchmarks, with a maximum speedup of 2.88x. For the second comparison, Phoenix-FSCS is faster on 13 benchmarks, slower on 14, and tied on one, with a maximum speedup of 2.91x. In production, Phoenix serves as the analysis substrate for static analysis and fuzzing tools that have uncovered hundreds of new bugs in open-source software and industrial deployments.
comment: Accepted in the Tool Demonstration Track, Joint Conference of ISSTA and SPLASH (SPLASH/ISSTA 2026)

title: Geometric Analysis of Token Selection in Multi-Head Attention
summary: We present a geometric framework for analysing multi-head attention in large language models (LLMs). Without altering the mechanism, we view standard attention through a top-N selection lens and study its behaviour directly in value-state space. We define geometric metrics - Precision, Recall, and F-score - to quantify separability between selected and non-selected tokens, and derive non-asymptotic bounds with explicit dependence on dimension and margin under empirically motivated assumptions (stable value norms with a compressed sink token, exponential similarity decay, and piecewise attention weight profiles). The theory predicts a small-N operating regime of strongest non-trivial separability and clarifies how sequence length and sink similarity shape the metrics. Empirically, across LLaMA-2-7B, Gemma-7B, and Mistral-7B, measurements closely track the theoretical envelopes: top-N selection sharpens separability, sink similarity correlates with Recall. We also found that in LLaMA-2-7B heads specialize into three regimes - Retriever, Mixer, Reset - with distinct geometric signatures. Overall, attention behaves as a structured geometric classifier with measurable criteria for token selection, offering head level interpretability and informing geometry-aware sparsification and design of attention in LLMs.

title: AROpt: An Optimization Method for Autoregressive Time Series Forecasting
summary: Current time-series forecasting models are primarily based on transformer-style neural networks. These models achieve long-term forecasting mainly by scaling up the model size rather than through genuinely autoregressive (AR) rollout. From the perspective of large language model training, traditional time-series forecasting model training ignores the monotonic error-growth heuristic. In this paper, we propose a novel training method for time-series forecasting that enforces two key properties: (1) AR prediction errors should increase with the forecasting horizon. Violations of this trend are interpreted as rollout inconsistency and are softly penalized during training, and (2) the method enables models to be able to concatenate short-term AR predictions to form flexible long-term forecasts. Empirical results demonstrate that our method establishes a new state-of-the-art across multiple benchmarks, achieving an MSE reduction of more than $10\%$ compared to iTransformer and other recent strong baselines. Furthermore, it enables short-horizon forecasting models to perform reliable long-term predictions at horizons over 7.5 times longer. Code is available at https://github.com/LizhengMathAi/AROpt

title: RAP: KV-Cache Compression via RoPE-Aligned Pruning
summary: Long-context inference in large language models (LLMs) is bottlenecked by the memory and compute of the key-value (KV) cache. Structured pruning is a direct way to shrink it: dropping the least useful channels of the W_k, W_v projection weights to reduce the output KV dimensions. However, modern LLMs apply Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) after the QK projections, which rotates feature dimensions in pairs. Therefore, removing individual channels breaks these pairs, corrupting RoPE's positional semantics and rendering the pruned model unusable. We propose RoPE-Aligned Pruning (RAP), which constrains the pruning granularity to RoPE-aligned pairs rather than individual channels: removing whole pairs to keep the rotation intact. Our evaluation across Llama, Mistral, and Qwen models from 3B to 14B shows that RAP preserves accuracy at 30% KV compression (retain ratio \r{ho} = 0.7), far outperforms RoPE-blind channel pruning, stays near the strongest low-rank method at lower attention cost, and composes with orthogonal methods such as quantization.

title: Exploring Silicon-Based Societies: An Early Study of the Moltbook Agent Community
comments: 11 pages, 3 figures. Improves clarity and exposition and corrects minor errors. Technical content and conclusions remain unchanged
summary: The rapid emergence of autonomous large language model agents has given rise to persistent, large-scale agent ecosystems whose collective behavior cannot be adequately understood through anecdotal observation or small-scale simulation. This paper introduces data-driven silicon sociology as a systematic empirical framework for studying social structure formation among interacting artificial agents. We present a pioneering large-scale data mining investigation of an in-the-wild agent society by analyzing Moltbook, a social platform designed primarily for agent-to-agent interaction. At the time of study, Moltbook hosted over 150,000 registered autonomous agents operating across thousands of agent-created sub-communities. Using programmatic and non-intrusive data acquisition, we collected and analyzed the textual descriptions of 12,758 submolts, which represent proactive sub-community partitioning activities within the ecosystem. Treating agent-authored descriptions as first-class observational artifacts, we apply rigorous preprocessing, contextual embedding, and unsupervised clustering techniques to uncover latent patterns of thematic organization and social space structuring. The results show that autonomous agents systematically organize collective space through reproducible patterns spanning human-mimetic interests, silicon-centric self-reflection, and early-stage economic and coordination behaviors. Rather than relying on predefined sociological taxonomies, these structures emerge directly from machine-generated data traces. This work establishes a methodological foundation for data-driven silicon sociology and demonstrates that data mining techniques can provide a powerful lens for understanding the organization and evolution of large autonomous agent societies.
